sentences.zh: 智慧有船艦千餘艘，屯據要害，兵甚勁。

translations.literal: Zhihui had more than a thousand ships, held strategic points, and his troops were very strong.
translations.idiomatic: Held strategic points, and his troops were very strong, and zhihui had more than a thousand ships.

sentences.zh: 素擊之，自旦至申，苦戰破之。

translations.literal: Su attacked him; from dawn to the shen hour they fought bitterly and broke him.
translations.idiomatic: In time, su attacked him; from dawn to the shen hour they fought bitterly and broke him.

sentences.zh: 智慧逃入海。

translations.literal: Zhihui fled into the sea.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihui escaped by sea.

sentences.zh: 躡之，從餘姚泛海趣永嘉。

translations.literal: Su pursued him, going from Yuyao by sea toward Yongjia.
translations.idiomatic: In time, su pursued him, going from Yuyao by sea toward Yongjia.

sentences.zh: 智慧來拒戰，素擊走，賊帥汪文進自稱天子，據東陽，署其徒蔡道人為司空，守樂安。

translations.literal: Zhihui came to resist; Su attacked and drove him off. Bandit chief Wang Wenjin styled himself Son of Heaven, held Dongyang, and appointed his follower Cai Daoren Minister of Works to guard Le'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zhihui came to resist; Su attacked and drove him off. Bandit chief Wang Wenjin — style name himself Son of Heaven, held Dongyang, and appointed his follower Cai Daoren Minister of Works to guard Le'an.

sentences.zh: 素進討。

translations.literal: Su advanced to attack.
translations.idiomatic: Su advanced to attack.

sentences.zh: 悉平之。

translations.literal: He pacified them all.
translations.idiomatic: He pacified them all.

sentences.zh: 又破永嘉賊帥沈孝徹。

translations.literal: He also defeated Yongjia bandit chief Shen Xiaoche.
translations.idiomatic: He likewise defeated Yongjia bandit chief Shen Xiaoche.

sentences.zh: 於是步道向天臺，指臨海郡。

translations.literal: He then marched overland toward Tiantai and aimed at Linhai commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Next he marched overland toward Tiantai and aimed at Linhai commandery.

sentences.zh: 遂捕遺逸，前後百餘戰，智慧遁守閩越。

translations.literal: He then captured stragglers; in more than a hundred battles before and after, Zhihui fled and held out in Min-Yue.
translations.idiomatic: He then captured stragglers. In more than a hundred battles before and after, Zhihui fled and held out in Min-Yue.

sentences.zh: 上以素久勞於外，詔令馳傳入朝，加子玄感上開府，賜彩八千段。

translations.literal: Because Su had long labored abroad, the emperor ordered him to enter court by rapid relay, granting his son Xuangan Senior Grand Master of the Palace and eight thousand lengths of colored silk.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered him to enter court by rapid relay, granting his son Xuangan Senior Grand Master of the Palace and eight thousand lengths of colored silk, and because Su had long labored abroad.

sentences.zh: 素以餘寇未殄，恐為後患，又自請行。

translations.literal: Su, because remaining bandits were not yet destroyed and feared they would become a later trouble, again requested to go on campaign himself.
translations.idiomatic: In time, su, because remaining bandits were not yet destroyed and feared they would become a later trouble, again requested to go on campaign himself.

sentences.zh: 詔以素為元帥，復乘傳至會稽。

translations.literal: An edict made Su commander-in-chief; he again rode relay to Kuaiji.
translations.idiomatic: By edict Su became commander-in-chief and once more traveled by post to Kuaiji.

sentences.zh: 先是，泉州人王國慶，南安豪族也，殺刺史劉弘，據州為亂。

translations.literal: Before this, Wang Guoqing of Quanzhou, a powerful clan of Nan'an, killed Regional Inspector Liu Hong and seized the province in rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In time, before this, Wang Guoqing of Quanzhou, a powerful clan of Nan'an, killed Regional Inspector Liu Hong and seized the province in rebellion.

sentences.zh: 自以海路艱阻，非北人所習，不設備伍。

translations.literal: He thought the sea route arduous and difficult and not what northerners were accustomed to, and made no preparations.
translations.idiomatic: And made no preparations, and he thought the sea route arduous and difficult and not what northerners were accustomed to.

sentences.zh: 素泛海奄至，國慶遑遽，棄州走。

translations.literal: Su crossed the sea and suddenly arrived; Guoqing was panic-stricken and abandoned the province and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In time, su crossed the sea and suddenly arrived; Guoqing was panic-stricken and abandoned the province and fled.

sentences.zh: 素分遣諸將，水陸追捕。

translations.literal: Su sent out his generals to pursue by land and sea.
translations.idiomatic: In time, su sent out his generals to pursue by land and sea.

sentences.zh: 時南海先有五六百家，居水為亡命，號曰遊艇子；

translations.literal: At that time in Nanhai there were first five or six hundred households living on the water as fugitives, called the Wandering Boat People;
translations.idiomatic: In time, at that time in Nanhai there were first five or six hundred households living on the water as fugitives, called the Wandering Boat People;

sentences.zh: 智慧、國慶欲往依之。

translations.literal: Zhihui and Guoqing wished to rely on them.
translations.idiomatic: In time, zhihui and Guoqing wished to rely on them.

sentences.zh: 素乃密令人說國慶，令斬智慧以自效。

translations.literal: Su secretly sent men to persuade Guoqing to kill Zhihui to prove his loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Su quietly sent envoys to persuade Guoqing to kill Zhihui as proof of loyalty.

sentences.zh: 因慶乃斬智慧於泉州。

translations.literal: Thereupon Guoqing killed Zhihui at Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: At that point Guoqing killed Zhihui at Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 自余支黨悉降，江南大定。

translations.literal: The remaining branches and factions all submitted, and the Jiangnan region was greatly settled.
translations.idiomatic: And the Jiangnan region was greatly settled, and the remaining branches and factions all submitted.

sentences.zh: 上遣左領軍將軍獨孤陀至浚儀迎勞，比到京師，問者日至。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Left Palace Guard General Dugu Tuo to Junyi to welcome and reward him; by the time he reached the capital, visitors came daily.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Left Palace Guard General Dugu Tuo to Junyi to welcome and reward him. By the time he reached the capital, visitors came daily.

sentences.zh: 拜素子玄獎儀同，賜黃金四十斤，加銀瓶，實以金錢，縑三千段、馬二百匹、羊三千口、田百頃、宅一區。

translations.literal: Su's son Xuanjiang was appointed Honorary Three Dukes and granted forty jin of gold, with a silver bottle filled with gold coins, three thousand lengths of silk, two hundred horses, three thousand sheep, a hundred qing of fields, and one residence.
translations.idiomatic: With a silver bottle filled with gold coins, three thousand lengths of silk, two hundred horses, three thousand sheep, a hundred qing of fields, and one residence, and su's son Xuanjiang was appointed Honorary Three Dukes and granted forty jin of gold.

sentences.zh: 代蘇威為尚書右僕射，與高熲專掌朝政。

translations.literal: He replaced Su Wei as Right Vice Minister of the Imperial Secretariat and together with Gao Jiong exclusively managed court and state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In time, he replaced Su Wei as Right Vice Minister of the Imperial Secretariat and together with Gao Jiong exclusively managed court and state affairs.

sentences.zh: 素性疏而辯，高下在心，朝貴之內，頗推高熲，敬牛弘，厚接薛道衡，視蘇威蔑如也。

translations.literal: Su's nature was bold and eloquent; high and low were in his heart. Among the honored of the court he fairly esteemed Gao Jiong, respected Niu Hong, treated Xue Daoheng generously, and looked on Su Wei with contempt.
translations.idiomatic: Respected Niu Hong, treated Xue Daoheng generously, and looked on Su Wei with contempt, and su's nature was bold and eloquent; high and low were in his heart. Among the honored of the court he fairly esteemed Gao Jiong.

sentences.zh: 自餘朝臣，多被陵轢。

translations.literal: Most other court ministers he bullied and insulted.
translations.idiomatic: In time, most other court ministers he bullied and insulted.

sentences.zh: 其才藝風調，優於高熲。

translations.literal: In talent, art, and bearing he was superior to Gao Jiong.
translations.idiomatic: In talent, art, ; bearing he was superior to Gao Jiong.

sentences.zh: 至於推誠體國，處物平當，有宰相識度，不如熲遠矣。

translations.literal: But in extending sincerity, embodying the state, treating things evenly, and the discernment of a chief minister he fell far short of Jiong.
translations.idiomatic: Embodying the state, treating things evenly, and the discernment of a chief minister he fell far short of Jiong, and but in extending sincerity.

sentences.zh: 尋令素監營仁壽宮，素遂夷山堙穀，督役嚴急，作者多死，宮側時聞鬼哭。

translations.literal: Before long Su was ordered to supervise construction of Renshou Palace; he leveled mountains and filled valleys, supervising labor with harsh urgency — many workers died, and by the palace one often heard ghosts weeping.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Su was ordered to supervise construction of Renshou Palace. He leveled mountains and filled valleys, supervising labor with harsh urgency — many workers died, and by the palace one often heard ghosts weeping.

sentences.zh: 及宮成，上令高熲前視，奏稱頗傷綺麗，大損人丁。

translations.literal: When the palace was finished the emperor ordered Gao Jiong to inspect it beforehand; he reported that it was rather excessively ornate and had greatly wasted human lives.
translations.idiomatic: When the palace was finished the emperor ordered Gao Jiong to inspect it beforehand. He reported that it was rather excessively ornate and had greatly wasted human lives.

sentences.zh: 帝不悅。

translations.literal: The emperor was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was displeased.

sentences.zh: 素懼，即於北門啟獨孤皇后曰：「帝王法有離宮別館，今天下太平，造一宮何足損費。

translations.literal: Su feared this and immediately at the North Gate reported to Empress Dugu: "Imperial law provides for detached palaces and lodges; now that the realm is at peace, to build one palace — what expense does that waste?
translations.idiomatic: Su feared this and immediately at the North Gate reported to Empress Dugu, "Imperial law provides for detached palaces and lodges. Now that the realm is at peace, to build one palace — what expense does that waste?

sentences.zh: 」後以此理諭上，上乃解。

translations.literal: " The empress used this reasoning to persuade the emperor, and the emperor thereupon relented.
translations.idiomatic: " The empress used this reasoning to persuade the emperor, and the emperor at that point relented.

sentences.zh: 於是賜錢百萬、綿絹三千段。

translations.literal: Thereupon he granted a million coins and three thousand lengths of silk and floss.
translations.idiomatic: At that point he granted a million coins and three thousand lengths of silk and floss.

sentences.zh: 開皇十八年，突厥達頭可汗犯塞，以素為靈州道行軍總管。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Kaihuang, Tujue Khan Datou invaded the frontier; Su was made campaigning commander-in-chief of the Lingzhou Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year of Kaihuang, Tujue Khan Datou invaded the frontier. Su was made campaigning commander-in-chief of the Lingzhou Circuit.

sentences.zh: 出塞討之，賜物二千段、黃金百斤。

translations.literal: He went beyond the frontier to attack them and was granted two thousand lengths of goods and a hundred jin of gold.
translations.idiomatic: In time, he went beyond the frontier to attack them and was granted two thousand lengths of goods and a hundred jin of gold.

sentences.zh: 先是諸將與虜戰，每慮胡騎奔突，皆戎車步騎相參，與鹿角為方陣，騎在內。

translations.literal: Before this, whenever generals fought the barbarians they always feared Hu cavalry charges and so mixed war chariots, infantry, and cavalry, forming a square with antlers — cavalry within.
translations.idiomatic: In time, before this, whenever generals fought the barbarians they always feared Hu cavalry charges and so mixed war chariots, infantry, and cavalry, forming a square with antlers — cavalry within.

sentences.zh: 素曰：「此乃自固之道。

translations.literal: Su said: "This is merely the way to protect oneself.
translations.idiomatic: Su said, "This is merely the way to protect oneself.

sentences.zh: 」於是悉除舊法，令諸軍為騎陣。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he completely abolished the old method and ordered all armies to form cavalry formations.
translations.idiomatic: " At that point he completely abolished the old method and ordered all armies to form cavalry formations.

sentences.zh: 達頭聞之，大喜，以為天賜，下馬仰天而拜，率精騎十餘萬至。

translations.literal: When Datou heard of this he was greatly pleased, thinking it a gift from Heaven; he dismounted, bowed toward the sky, and came with more than a hundred thousand elite horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: When Datou heard of this he was greatly pleased, thinking it a gift from Heaven. He dismounted, bowed toward the sky, and came with more than a hundred thousand elite horsemen.

sentences.zh: 素奮擊，大破。

translations.literal: Su struck hard and broke them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: In time, su struck hard and broke them utterly.

sentences.zh: 達頭被重創而遁，眾號哭而去。

translations.literal: Datou suffered grave wounds and fled; his troops wailed and departed.
translations.idiomatic: In time, datou suffered grave wounds and fled; his troops wailed and departed.

sentences.zh: 優詔賜縑二萬匹及萬釘寶帶，加子玄感位大將軍，玄獎、玄縱、積善並上儀同。

translations.literal: A gracious edict granted twenty thousand bolts of silk and a precious belt studded with ten thousand nails; his son Xuangan was made Grand General, and Xuanjiang, Xuanzong, and Jishan were all made Honorary Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: A gracious edict granted twenty thousand bolts of silk and a precious belt studded with ten thousand nails. His son Xuangan was made Grand General, and Xuanjiang, Xuanzong, and Jishan were all made Honorary Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 素多權略，乘機赴敵，應變無方。

translations.literal: Su had many stratagems; he seized opportunities to meet the enemy and adapted without fixed method.
translations.idiomatic: Su had many stratagems. He seized opportunities to meet the enemy and adapted without fixed method.

sentences.zh: 然大抵馭戎嚴整，有犯令者，立斬無所寬貸。

translations.literal: Yet in general he controlled the army with strict discipline; those who violated orders were beheaded on the spot without leniency.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in general he controlled the army with strict discipline. Those who violated orders were beheaded on the spot without leniency.

sentences.zh: 每將臨寇，輒求人過失而斬之，多者百餘人，少不下數十，流血盈前，言笑自若。

translations.literal: Whenever he was about to face the enemy he would seek out men's faults and behead them — more than a hundred in some cases, never fewer than several dozen; blood filled the ground before him yet he spoke and laughed as usual.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he was about to face the enemy he would seek out men's faults and behead them — more than a hundred in some cases, never fewer than several dozen. Blood filled the ground before him yet he spoke and laughed as usual.

sentences.zh: 及對陣，先令一二百人赴敵，陷陣則已，如不能陷而還，無問多少，悉斬之。

translations.literal: When facing the enemy he first sent one or two hundred men to attack; if they broke the formation that was enough, but if they could not break through and returned, regardless of number all were beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: When facing the enemy he first sent one or two hundred men to attack. If they broke the formation that was enough, but if they could not break through and returned, regardless of number all were beheaded.

sentences.zh: 又令二百人復進，還如向法。

translations.literal: He then sent two hundred men forward again; if they returned it was handled by the same rule.
translations.idiomatic: Next he sent two hundred men forward again; if they returned it was handled by the same rule.

sentences.zh: 將士股栗，有必死心，由是戰無不勝，稱為名將。

translations.literal: Officers and soldiers trembled in their thighs and had hearts set on certain death; therefore in battle they were never defeated, and he was called a famous general.
translations.idiomatic: Officers and soldiers trembled in their thighs and had hearts set on certain death. Therefore in battle they were never defeated, and he was called a famous general.

sentences.zh: 素時貴幸，言無不從。

translations.literal: At that time Su was honored and favored; none of his words went unheeded.
translations.idiomatic: In time, at that time Su was honored and favored; none of his words went unheeded.

sentences.zh: 其從素征代者，微功必錄。

translations.literal: Those who followed Su on campaigns against the northern barbarians had even slight merit recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Even men who campaigned under Su against the northern tribes had the smallest deed entered in the records.

sentences.zh: 至於他將，雖大功，多為文吏所譴卻。

translations.literal: As for other generals, even for great merit they were often reproached and rejected by clerical officials.
translations.idiomatic: Even for great merit they were often reproached and rejected by clerical officials, and as for other generals.

sentences.zh: 故素雖嚴忍，士亦以此願從。

translations.literal: Therefore although Su was harsh and cruel, soldiers for this reason were willing to follow him.
translations.idiomatic: Soldiers for this reason were willing to follow him, and therefore although Su was harsh and cruel.

sentences.zh: 二十年，晉王廣為靈、朔道行軍元帥，素為長史，王卑躬交素。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, the Prince of Jin, Guang, was campaigning commander-in-chief of the Ling and Shuo Circuit and Su was Chief Administrator; the prince bowed humbly in treating Su.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, the Prince of Jin, Guang, was campaigning commander-in-chief of the Ling and Shuo Circuit and Su was Chief Administrator. The prince bowed humbly in treating Su.

sentences.zh: 及為太子，素之謀也。

translations.literal: When he became Crown Prince, it was Su's plot.
translations.idiomatic: It was Su's plot, and when he became Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 仁壽初，代高熲為尚書左僕射，賜良馬十匹、牝馬二百匹、奴婢百口。

translations.literal: Early in Renshou he replaced Gao Jiong as Left Vice Minister of the Imperial Secretariat and was granted ten fine horses, two hundred mares, and a hundred male and female servants.
translations.idiomatic: Two hundred mares, and a hundred male and female servants, and early in Renshou he replaced Gao Jiong as Left Vice Minister of the Imperial Secretariat and was granted ten fine horses.

sentences.zh: 其年，以素為行軍元帥，出雲中擊突厥，連破之。

translations.literal: That year Su was made campaigning commander-in-chief, went out from Yunzhong to attack the Tujue, and broke them repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: Went out from Yunzhong to attack the Tujue, and broke them repeatedly, and that year Su was made campaigning commander-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 突厥走，追至夜及之。

translations.literal: The Tujue fled; he pursued them and caught up by night.
translations.idiomatic: In time, the Tujue fled; he pursued them and caught up by night.

sentences.zh: 將復戰，恐賊越逸，令其騎稍後，於是親將兩騎並降突厥二人與虜並行，不之覺也。

translations.literal: About to fight again, fearing the enemy would escape, he ordered his cavalry to hang back; he personally led two horsemen together with two surrendered Tujue to ride alongside the barbarians, and they did not notice.
translations.idiomatic: About to fight again, fearing the enemy would escape, he ordered his cavalry to hang back. He personally led two horsemen together with two surrendered Tujue to ride alongside the barbarians, and they did not notice.

sentences.zh: 侯其頓舍未定，趣後騎掩擊，大破之。

translations.literal: When he saw they had not yet settled from halting, he urged the rear cavalry to strike from cover and broke them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: Seeing they had not yet yet settled from halting, he urged the rear cavalry to strike from cover and broke them utterly.

sentences.zh: 自是突厥遠遁，磧南無復虜庭。

translations.literal: From this the Tujue fled far away and south of the desert there was no barbarian court again.
translations.idiomatic: In time, from this the Tujue fled far away and south of the desert there was no barbarian court again.

sentences.zh: 以功進子玄感位柱國，玄縱為淮南郡公，賞物二萬段。

translations.literal: For merit his son Xuangan was advanced to Pillar of State, Xuanzong was made Duke of Huainan Commandery, and he was granted twenty thousand lengths of goods.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong was made Duke of Huainan Commandery, and he was granted twenty thousand lengths of goods, and for merit his son Xuangan was advanced to Pillar of State.

sentences.zh: 及獻皇后崩，山陵制度多出於素。

translations.literal: When Empress Xian died, the regulations for the mountain tomb mostly came from Su.
translations.idiomatic: The regulations for the mountain tomb mostly came from Su, and when Empress Xian died.

sentences.zh: 上善之，下詔曰：「君為元首，臣則股肱，共理百姓，義同一體。

translations.literal: The emperor approved and issued an edict: "The ruler is the head and ministers are the arms and legs; together they govern the people — in duty they are one body.
translations.idiomatic: In time, the emperor approved and issued an edict: "The ruler is the head and ministers are the arms and legs; together they govern the people — in duty they are one body.

sentences.zh: 上柱國、尚書左僕射、仁壽宮大監、越國公素，志度恢弘，機鑒明遠，懷佐時之略，包經國之才。

translations.literal: Superior Pillar of State, Left Vice Minister of the Imperial Secretariat, Grand Supervisor of Renshou Palace, Duke of Yue Su — his resolve and measure are vast, his insight clear and far-reaching; he holds strategies to assist the age and talent to maintain the state.
translations.idiomatic: Superior Pillar of State, Left Vice Minister of the Imperial Secretariat, Grand Supervisor of Renshou Palace, Duke of Yue Su — his resolve and measure are vast, his insight clear and far-reaching. He holds strategies to assist the age and talent to maintain the state.

sentences.zh: 王業初基，霸圖肇建，策名委質，受脤出師，禽翦凶魁，克平虢、鄭。

translations.literal: When the royal enterprise was first founded and the hegemonic design newly established, he pledged his name and entrusted his substance, received the sacrificial meat and went forth as general, captured and cut down the chief villains, and pacified Guo and Zheng.
translations.idiomatic: He pledged his name and entrusted his substance, received the sacrificial meat and went forth as general, captured and cut down the chief villains, and pacified Guo and Zheng, and when the royal enterprise was first founded and the hegemonic design newly established.

sentences.zh: 頻承廟算，揚旌江表；

translations.literal: Repeatedly receiving plans from the temple, he raised banners south of the Yangtze;
translations.idiomatic: Again and again he carried out plans from the imperial temple, raising banners south of the Yangtze;

sentences.zh: 每稟戎律，長驅塞垣。

translations.literal: Whenever he received military law he drove far along the frontier wall.
translations.idiomatic: Each time war orders came down he drove deep along the frontier.

sentences.zh: 南指而吳越肅清，北臨而獯獫摧服。

translations.literal: Pointing south, Wu and Yue were cleared and pacified; pressing north, the Xianyun were broken and subdued.
translations.idiomatic: In time, pointing south, Wu and Yue were cleared and pacified; pressing north, the Xianyun were broken and subdued.

sentences.zh: 自居端揆，參贊機衡，當朝正色，直言無隱。

translations.literal: Once he occupied the chief minister's seat he took part in planning within the command tent, maintained upright color at court, and spoke bluntly without concealment.
translations.idiomatic: Maintained upright color at court, and spoke bluntly without concealment, and once he occupied the chief minister's seat he took part in planning within the command tent.

sentences.zh: 論文則詞藻從橫，語武則權奇間出，既文且武，唯朕所命。

translations.literal: In literature his words were brilliant and unrestrained; in martial affairs his stratagems were singular and outstanding — both literary and martial, as only I command.
translations.idiomatic: As only I command, and in literature his words were brilliant and unrestrained; in martial affairs his stratagems were singular and outstanding — both literary and martial.

sentences.zh: 任使之處，夙夜無怠。

translations.literal: In every place of appointment he was untiring day and night.
translations.idiomatic: In time, in every place of appointment he was untiring day and night.

sentences.zh: 獻皇后奄離六宮，遠日雲及，塋兆安厝，委素經紀。

translations.literal: Empress Xian suddenly departed the six palaces; the distant day drew near, and the burial site and resting place were entrusted to Su to arrange.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Xian suddenly departed the six palaces. The distant day drew near, and the burial site and resting place were entrusted to Su to arrange.

sentences.zh: 然葬事依禮，唯卜泉石，至如吉凶，不由於此。

translations.literal: Yet burial affairs follow rites — one seeks only spring and stone; as for fortune and misfortune, it does not depend on this.
translations.idiomatic: It does not depend on this, and yet burial affairs follow rites — one seeks only spring and stone; as for fortune and misfortune.

sentences.zh: 素義存奉上，情深體國，欲使幽明俱泰，永保無窮。

translations.literal: Su's righteousness lay in serving the ruler above and his feeling deep in embodying the state; he wished to make the hidden and manifest both at peace and preserve them without end.
translations.idiomatic: Su's righteousness lay in serving the ruler above and his feeling deep in embodying the state. He wished to make the hidden and manifest both at peace and preserve them without end.

sentences.zh: 以為陰陽之書，聖人所作，禍福之理，特須審慎。

translations.literal: He considered that books of yin and yang were made by sages and that the principles of fortune and misfortune require especial caution.
translations.idiomatic: In time, he considered that books of yin and yang were made by sages and that the principles of fortune and misfortune require especial caution.

sentences.zh: 乃遍曆川原，親自占擇，志圖元吉，孜孜不已。

translations.literal: He therefore traveled all rivers and plains, personally divined and selected, striving for supreme good fortune without ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Personally divined and selected, striving for supreme good fortune without ceasing, and he therefore traveled all rivers and plains.

sentences.zh: 遂得神皋福壤，營建山陵。

translations.literal: He thus obtained divine highland and blessed soil and built the mountain tomb.
translations.idiomatic: In time, he thus obtained divine highland and blessed soil and built the mountain tomb.

sentences.zh: 論素此心，事極誠孝，豈與平戎定寇，比其功業，若不加褒賞，何以申茲勸勵。

translations.literal: Considering Su's heart in this matter, his conduct reached utmost sincere filial piety — how could pacifying barbarians and settling bandits compare with this achievement? If reward and praise are not added, how can this encouragement be expressed?
translations.idiomatic: In time, considering Su's heart in this matter, his conduct reached utmost sincere filial piety — how could pacifying barbarians and settling bandits compare with this achievement? If reward and praise are not added, how can this encouragement be expressed?

sentences.zh: 可別封一子義康郡公、邑萬戶，子子孫孫承襲不絕，餘如故。

translations.literal: One of his sons may separately be enfeoffed Duke of Yikang Commandery with a fief of ten thousand households, to be inherited by sons and grandsons without end; the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: To be inherited by sons and grandsons without end; the rest as before, and one of his sons may separately be enfeoffed Duke of Yikang Commandery with a fief of ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 」並賜田三十頃、絹萬匹、米萬石；

translations.literal: " He was also granted thirty qing of fields, ten thousand bolts of silk, and ten thousand piculs of rice;
translations.idiomatic: " They also granted him thirty qing of fields, ten thousand bolts of silk, and ten thousand piculs of rice;

sentences.zh: 金缽一，實以金；

translations.literal: one gold bowl filled with gold;
translations.idiomatic: a gold bowl filled with gold;

sentences.zh: 銀缽一，實以珠；

translations.literal: one silver bowl filled with pearls;
translations.idiomatic: a silver bowl filled with pearls;

sentences.zh: 並綾錦五百段。

translations.literal: and five hundred lengths of damask and brocade.
translations.idiomatic: In time, and five hundred lengths of damask and brocade.

sentences.zh: 時素貴寵日隆。

translations.literal: At that time Su's honor and favor grew daily.
translations.idiomatic: In time, at that time Su's honor and favor grew daily.

sentences.zh: 其弟約、從父文思、弟紀及族父異並尚書、列卿，諸子無汗馬勞，位柱國、刺史。

translations.literal: His younger brother Yue, his father's cousin Wensi, his younger brother Ji, and his clan uncle Yi were all Directors and chief ministers; his sons without sweat-of-horse merit held the ranks of Pillar of State and Regional Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Yue, his father's cousin Wensi, his younger brother Ji, and his clan uncle Yi were all Directors and chief ministers. His sons without sweat-of-horse merit held the ranks of Pillar of State and Regional Inspector.

sentences.zh: 家僮數千，後庭妓妾曳綺羅者以千數；

translations.literal: Household slaves numbered in the thousands; courtesans and concubines trailing gauze and silk numbered in the thousands;
translations.idiomatic: In time, household slaves numbered in the thousands; courtesans and concubines trailing gauze and silk numbered in the thousands;

sentences.zh: 第宅華侈，制擬宮禁。

translations.literal: residences were lavish and extravagant, modeled on the palace precincts.
translations.idiomatic: Modeled on the palace precincts, and residences were lavish and extravagant.

sentences.zh: 有鮑亨者善屬文，殷胄者工草隸，並江南士人，因高智慧沒為奴。

translations.literal: There were Bao Heng, skilled at literary composition, and Yin Zhou, skilled at cursive and clerical script — both scholars of the Jiangnan region who because of Gao Zhihui were taken as slaves.
translations.idiomatic: Skilled at literary composition, and Yin Zhou, skilled at cursive and clerical script — both scholars of the Jiangnan region who because of Gao Zhihui were taken as slaves, and there were Bao Heng.

sentences.zh: 親戚故吏，布列清顯。

translations.literal: Kinsmen and former subordinates were spread among eminent posts.
translations.idiomatic: In time, kinsmen and former subordinates were spread among eminent posts.

sentences.zh: 其盛近古未聞。

translations.literal: Such splendor had not been heard of in recent antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Such splendor had scarcely been seen in recent memory.

sentences.zh: 煬帝初為太子，忌蜀王秀，與素謀之，構成其罪，後竟廢黜。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yang first became Crown Prince he feared the Prince of Shu, Xiu, and plotted with Su to construct crimes against him; in the end Xiu was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Yang first became Crown Prince he feared the Prince of Shu, Xiu, and plotted with Su to construct crimes against him. In the end Xiu was deposed.

sentences.zh: 朝臣有違忤者，雖至誠體國如賀若弼、史萬歲、李綱、柳彧等，素皆陰中之。

translations.literal: Court ministers who opposed him — even those who with utmost sincerity embodied the state like He Ruo Bi, Shi Wansui, Li Gang, and Liu Yu — Su all secretly struck at them.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Wansui, Li Gang, and Liu Yu — Su all secretly struck at them, and court ministers who opposed him — even those who with utmost sincerity embodied the state like He Ruo Bi.

sentences.zh: 若有附會及親戚，雖無才用，必加進擢。

translations.literal: If there were flatterers or kinsmen, even without talent they were sure to be promoted.
translations.idiomatic: Even without talent they were sure to be promoted, and if there were flatterers or kinsmen.

sentences.zh: 朝廷靡然，莫不畏附。

translations.literal: The court leaned toward him; none did not fear and attach themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In time, the court leaned toward him; none did not fear and attach themselves.

sentences.zh: 唯兵部尚書柳述，以帝婿之重，數於上前面折素。

translations.literal: Only Minister of the Seven Arms Liu Shu, by weight of being the emperor's son-in-law, repeatedly rebuked Su to his face before the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: By weight of being the emperor's son-in-law, repeatedly rebuked Su to his face before the emperor, and only Minister of the Seven Arms Liu Shu.

sentences.zh: 大理卿梁毗，抗表言素作威作福。

translations.literal: Director of Justice Liang Pi memorialized in protest that Su was making might and making favor.
translations.idiomatic: In time, director of Justice Liang Pi memorialized in protest that Su was making might and making favor.

sentences.zh: 上漸疏忌之，後因出敕曰：「僕射，國之宰輔，不可躬親細務，但三五日一度向省評論大事。

translations.literal: The emperor gradually grew distant and suspicious of him; later he issued an edict: "The Vice Minister is the state's chief assistant and must not personally attend to minor affairs — only once every three or five days go to the ministry to discuss great affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor gradually grew distant and suspicious of him. Later he issued an edict: "The Vice Minister is the state's chief assistant and must not personally attend to minor affairs — only once every three or five days go to the ministry to discuss great affairs.

sentences.zh: 」外示優崇，實奪之權，終仁壽之末，不復通判省事。

translations.literal: " Outwardly showing honor and elevation, in reality his power was taken; to the end of Renshou he no longer jointly handled ministry business.
translations.idiomatic: " Outwardly showing honor and elevation, in reality his power was taken. To the end of Renshou he no longer jointly handled ministry business.

sentences.zh: 上賜王公已下射，素箭為第一，上手以外國所獻金精盤價直巨萬以賜之。

translations.literal: The emperor granted archery to princes and dukes downward; Su's arrow was first, and the emperor personally gave him a golden essence dish from foreign tribute worth tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor granted archery to princes and dukes downward. Su's arrow was first, and the emperor personally gave him a golden essence dish from foreign tribute worth tens of thousands.

sentences.zh: 四年，從幸仁壽宮，宴賜重疊。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed the emperor to Renshou Palace and received banquets and gifts in layers.
translations.idiomatic: In time, in the fourth year he followed the emperor to Renshou Palace and received banquets and gifts in layers.

sentences.zh: 及上不豫，素與兵部尚書柳述、黃門侍郎元岩等入侍疾。

translations.literal: When the emperor fell ill Su together with Minister of the Seven Arms Liu Shu, Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Yuan Yan, and others entered to attend the illness.
translations.idiomatic: Once the emperor fell ill Su together with Minister of the Seven Arms Liu Shu, Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate Yuan Yan, and others entered to attend the illness.

sentences.zh: 時皇太子入居大寶殿，慮上有不諱，須豫防擬，乃手自為書，封出問素。

translations.literal: At that time the Crown Prince had entered and occupied the Great Treasure Hall; fearing the emperor might die, he needed to prepare in advance, and personally wrote a letter, sealed it, and sent it out to ask Su.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Crown Prince had entered and occupied the Great Treasure Hall. Fearing the emperor might die, he needed to prepare in advance, and personally wrote a letter, sealed it, and sent it out to ask Su.

sentences.zh: 素條錄事狀，以報太子。

translations.literal: Su listed the circumstances item by item and reported to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: In time, su listed the circumstances item by item and reported to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 宮人潛送於上，上覽而大恚。

translations.literal: A palace woman secretly sent it to the emperor; the emperor read it and was greatly enraged.
translations.idiomatic: In time, a palace woman secretly sent it to the emperor; the emperor read it and was greatly enraged.

sentences.zh: 所寵陳貴人又言太子無禮。

translations.literal: The favored Lady Chen also said the Crown Prince was disrespectful.
translations.idiomatic: The favored Lady Chen also reported that the Crown Prince had been disrespectful.

sentences.zh: 上遂發怒，欲召庶人勇。

translations.literal: The emperor thereupon grew angry and wished to summon the commoner Yong.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor at that point grew angry and wished to summon the commoner Yong.

sentences.zh: 太子謀之素，素矯詔追東宮兵士帖上臺宿衛，門禁出入，並取宇文述、郭衍節度。

translations.literal: The Crown Prince plotted with Su; Su forged an edict to recall Eastern Palace soldiers to garrison the upper platform as guards; control of gate passage in and out was entirely taken by Yuwen Shu and Guo Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The Crown Prince plotted with Su. Su forged an edict to recall Eastern Palace soldiers to garrison the upper platform as guards. Control of gate passage in and out was entirely taken by Yuwen Shu and Guo Yan.

sentences.zh: 又令張衡侍疾。

translations.literal: He also ordered Zhang Heng to attend the illness.
translations.idiomatic: He likewise ordered Zhang Heng to attend the illness.

sentences.zh: 上以此日崩，由是頗有異論。

translations.literal: The emperor died that day; for this there were many differing opinions.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor died that day; afterward many questioned how it had happened.

sentences.zh: 會漢王諒反，遣茹茹天保往東蒲州，燒斷河橋，又遣王𨈭子並力拒守。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Han, Liang, rebelled he sent Ruru Tianbao to Eastern Puzhou to burn and break the river bridge, and sent Wang Rongzi with combined force to hold and defend.
translations.idiomatic: After the Prince of Han, Liang, rebelled he sent Ruru Tianbao to Eastern Puzhou to burn and break the river bridge, and sent Wang Rongzi with combined force to hold and defend.

sentences.zh: 素將輕騎五千襲之。

translations.literal: Su led five thousand light cavalry to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: In time, su led five thousand light cavalry to strike them.

sentences.zh: 潛於渭口宵濟，比明擊之。

translations.literal: Secretly at Wei Ford he crossed by night; by dawn he attacked.
translations.idiomatic: In time, secretly at Wei Ford he crossed by night; by dawn he attacked.

sentences.zh: 天保敗，𨈭子懼，以城降。

translations.literal: Tianbao was defeated; Rongzi feared and surrendered the city.
translations.idiomatic: In time, tianbao was defeated; Rongzi feared and surrendered the city.

sentences.zh: 有詔征還。

translations.literal: An edict ordered him recalled.
translations.idiomatic: An edict recalled him.

sentences.zh: 初素將行，計日破賊，皆如所量。

translations.literal: When Su was about to go he calculated the days to break the rebels — all matched his estimate.
translations.idiomatic: As Su prepared to depart he calculated the days to break the rebels — all matched his estimate.

sentences.zh: 帝於是以素為并州道行軍總管、河北道安撫大使，討諒。

translations.literal: The emperor therefore made Su campaigning commander-in-chief of the Bingzhou Circuit and Pacification Commissioner of the Hebei Circuit to attack Liang.
translations.idiomatic: In time, the emperor therefore made Su campaigning commander-in-chief of the Bingzhou Circuit and Pacification Commissioner of the Hebei Circuit to attack Liang.

sentences.zh: 時晉、絳、呂三州並為諒城守，素各以二千人縻之而去。

translations.literal: At that time Jin, Jiang, and Lü provinces all held out for Liang; Su tied down each with two thousand men and departed.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Jin, Jiang, and Lü provinces all held out for Liang. Su tied down each with two thousand men and departed.

sentences.zh: 諒遣趙子開擁眾十餘萬，築絕徑路，屯據高壁，佈陣五十里。

translations.literal: Liang sent Zhao Zikai with more than a hundred thousand troops, blocking the narrow path, holding high walls, and deploying formations for fifty li.
translations.idiomatic: Blocking the narrow path, holding high walls, and deploying formations for fifty li, and liang sent Zhao Zikai with more than a hundred thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 素令諸將以兵臨之，自以奇兵深入霍山，緣崖谷而進，直指其營，一戰破之，諒所署介州刺史梁修羅屯介休，聞素至，懼，棄城而走。

translations.literal: Su ordered the generals to press them with troops while he himself with a surprise force went deep into Huo Mountain, advancing along cliffs and ravines straight at their camp; in one battle he broke them. Liang's appointed Regional Inspector of Jiezhou Liang Xiuluo garrisoned Jiexiu; when he heard Su had arrived he feared and abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Su ordered the generals to press them with troops while he himself with a surprise force went deep into Huo Mountain, advancing along cliffs and ravines straight at their camp. In one battle he broke them. Liang's appointed Regional Inspector of Jiezhou Liang Xiuluo garrisoned Jiexiu; when he heard Su had arrived he feared and abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 進至清源，去并州三十里。

translations.literal: Advancing to Qingyuan, thirty li from Bingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty li from Bingzhou, and advancing to Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 率其將王世宗、趙子開、蕭摩訶等來拒戰，又擊破之，禽蕭摩訶。

translations.literal: Liang's generals Wang Shizong, Zhao Zikai, Xiao Mohe, and others came to resist; he again attacked and broke them and captured Xiao Mohe.
translations.idiomatic: Liang's generals Wang Shizong, Zhao Zikai, Xiao Mohe, and others came to resist. He again attacked and broke them and captured Xiao Mohe.

sentences.zh: 退保并州，素進兵圍之。

translations.literal: They retreated to hold Bingzhou; Su advanced and besieged it.
translations.idiomatic: In time, they retreated to hold Bingzhou; Su advanced and besieged it.

sentences.zh: 諒窮而降，餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: Liang was driven to extremity and surrendered; the remaining factions were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In time, liang was driven to extremity and surrendered; the remaining factions were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 帝遣素弟修武公約齎手詔勞，素上表陳謝。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Su's younger brother, Duke of Xiuwu Yue, bearing an imperial letter of consolation; Su memorialized in thanks.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Su's younger brother, Duke of Xiuwu Yue, bearing an imperial letter of consolation. Su memorialized in thanks.

sentences.zh: 其月，還京師。

translations.literal: That month he returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That month he went back to the capital.

sentences.zh: 從駕幸洛陽，以素領營東京大監。

translations.literal: Following the imperial carriage to Luoyang, Su was made Grand Supervisor of the Eastern Capital camp.
translations.idiomatic: Su was made Grand Supervisor of the Eastern Capital camp, and following the imperial carriage to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 以平諒功，拜其子萬石、仁行、侄玄挺皆儀同三司，賚物五萬段、羅綺千匹、諒之妓妾二十人。

translations.literal: For pacifying Liang his sons Wanshi and Renxing and nephew Xuanting were all made Honorary Three Dukes; he was granted fifty thousand lengths of goods, a thousand bolts of silk gauze, and twenty of Liang's courtesans.
translations.idiomatic: For pacifying Liang his sons Wanshi and Renxing and nephew Xuanting were all made Honorary Three Dukes. He was granted fifty thousand lengths of goods, a thousand bolts of silk gauze, and twenty of Liang's courtesans.

sentences.zh: 大業元年，遷尚書令賜東京甲第一區、物二千段，尋拜太師，餘官如故。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daye he was transferred to Minister of the Left and granted one superior residence in the Eastern Capital and two thousand lengths of goods; before long he was made Grand Preceptor, remaining in other posts as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Daye he was transferred to Minister of the Left and granted one superior residence in the Eastern Capital and two thousand lengths of goods. Before long he was made Grand Preceptor, remaining in other posts as before.

sentences.zh: 前後賞錫不可勝計。

translations.literal: Rewards and gifts before and after were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In time, rewards and gifts before and after were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 明年，拜司徒，改封楚公，真食二千五百戶。

translations.literal: The next year he was made Minister of Education and his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Chu with a fief of two thousand five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In time, the next year he was made Minister of Education and his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Chu with a fief of two thousand five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 其年病薨，諡曰景武。

translations.literal: That year he died of illness; posthumous title Jingwu.
translations.idiomatic: That year illness took him; posthumous title Jingwu.

sentences.zh: 贈光祿大夫、太尉公、弘農河東絳郡臨汾文城河內汲郡長平上黨河十郡太守，給轀輬車、班劍三十人、前後部羽葆鼓吹、粟麥五千石、物五千段，鴻臚監護喪事。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Grand Master of Splendor, Grand Commandant, and Grand Administrator of ten commanderies including Hongnong, Hedong, Jiang, Fen, Wen, Cheng, Henei, Ji, Changping, and Shangdang; granted a funeral carriage, thirty guards with swords, front and rear ceremonial guard musicians, five thousand piculs of millet and wheat, and five thousand lengths of goods; the Superintendent of Dependencies supervised the funeral.
translations.idiomatic: Posthumously granted Grand Master of Splendor, Grand Commandant, and Grand Administrator of ten commanderies including Hongnong, Hedong, Jiang, Fen, Wen, Cheng, Henei, Ji, Changping, and Shangdang. Granted a funeral carriage, thirty guards with swords, front and rear ceremonial guard musicians, five thousand piculs of millet and wheat, and five thousand lengths of goods; the Superintendent of Dependencies supervised the funeral.

sentences.zh: 帝又下詔立碑，以彰盛美。

translations.literal: The emperor also issued an edict to erect a stele to display his great merit.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor also ordered a stele erected to display his great merit.

sentences.zh: 素嘗以五言詩七百字贈番州刺史薛道衡，詞氣穎拔，風韻秀上，為一時盛作。

translations.literal: Su once gave Regional Inspector of Fanzhou Xue Daoheng a five-character poem of seven hundred words; its wording was sharp and elevated and its tone elegant — a masterpiece of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Su once gave Regional Inspector of Fanzhou Xue Daoheng a five-character poem of seven hundred words. Its wording was sharp and elevated and its tone elegant — a masterpiece of the age.

sentences.zh: 未幾而卒，道衡歎曰：「人之將死，其言也善，若是乎！

translations.literal: Before long he died; Daoheng sighed: "When a man is about to die, his words are good — is it like this!
translations.idiomatic: Before long he died. Daoheng sighed, "When a man is about to die, his words are good — is it like this!

sentences.zh: 」《集》十卷。

translations.literal: " His Collected Works were ten scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: " His Collected Works were ten scrolls.

sentences.zh: 素雖有建立策及平楊諒功，然特為帝猜忌，外示殊禮，內情甚薄。

translations.literal: Although Su had achievements in founding strategy and merit in pacifying Yang Liang, the emperor was especially suspicious of him — outwardly showing special courtesy, inwardly his feeling was very thin.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was especially suspicious of him — outwardly showing special courtesy, inwardly his feeling was very thin, and although Su had achievements in founding strategy and merit in pacifying Yang Liang.

sentences.zh: 太史言楚分野有大喪，因改封素于楚。

translations.literal: The Grand Astrologer said the Chu asterism would suffer great mourning; therefore Su's enfeoffment was changed to Chu.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Astrologer said the Chu asterism would suffer great mourning; Su's enfeoffment was therefore changed to Chu.

sentences.zh: 寢疾之日，帝每令名醫診侯，賜以上藥；

translations.literal: During his illness the emperor repeatedly sent famous physicians to examine him and granted superior medicines;
translations.idiomatic: In time, during his illness the emperor repeatedly sent famous physicians to examine him and granted superior medicines;

sentences.zh: 然密問醫人，恆恐不死。

translations.literal: Yet he secretly questioned the physicians, always fearing Su would not die.
translations.idiomatic: Always fearing Su would not die, and yet he secretly questioned the physicians.

sentences.zh: 素又自知名位已極，不肯服藥，變不將慎。

translations.literal: Su also knew himself that rank and position had reached their limit; he refused to take medicine and grew careless in self-restraint.
translations.idiomatic: Su also knew himself that rank and position had reached their limit. He refused to take medicine and grew careless in self-restraint.

sentences.zh: 每語弟約曰：「我豈須更活邪？」

translations.literal: He often said to his younger brother Yue: "Do I still need to go on living?"
translations.idiomatic: He often said to his younger brother Yue, "Do I still need to go on living?"

sentences.zh: 素貪財貨，營求產業，東西京居宅侈麗，朝毀夕復，營繕無已。

translations.literal: Su was greedy for wealth and goods and schemed for estates; residences in the eastern and western capitals were lavish, destroyed one morning and rebuilt by evening, construction and repair without end.
translations.idiomatic: Su was greedy for wealth and goods and schemed for estates. Residences in the eastern and western capitals were lavish, destroyed one morning and rebuilt by evening, construction and repair without end.

sentences.zh: 爰及諸方都會之處，邸店水磑田宅以千百數。

translations.literal: Extending to major cities in all regions, inns, water mills, fields, and houses numbered in the hundreds and thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Inns, water mills, fields, and houses numbered in the hundreds and thousands, and extending to major cities in all regions.

sentences.zh: 時議以此鄙之。

translations.literal: Public opinion despised him for this.
translations.idiomatic: People of the time looked down on him for this.

sentences.zh: 子玄感。

translations.literal: His son Xuangan.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Xuangan.

sentences.zh: 玄感少時晚成，人多謂之癡。

translations.literal: Xuangan matured late in youth; many called him dull.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan matured slowly in youth; many called him dull.

sentences.zh: 唯素每謂所親曰：「此兒不癡也。

translations.literal: Only Su often told those close to him: "This boy is not dull.
translations.idiomatic: Only Su often told those close to him, "This boy is not dull.

sentences.zh: 」及長，美須髯，儀貌雄俊，好讀書，便騎射。

translations.literal: " When he grew up he had a fine beard, a heroic and handsome appearance, loved reading, and was skilled at mounted archery.
translations.idiomatic: " As an adult he had a fine beard, a heroic and handsome appearance, loved reading, and was skilled at mounted archery.

sentences.zh: 弱冠，以父軍功位柱國，與其父俱為第二品，朝會則齊列。

translations.literal: At his capping, through his father's military merit he held the rank of Pillar of State; he and his father were both second rank and stood in the same row at court assemblies.
translations.idiomatic: At his capping, through his father's military merit he held the rank of Pillar of State. He and his father were both second rank and stood in the same row at court assemblies.

sentences.zh: 後文帝命玄感降一等，玄感拜謝曰：「不意陛下寵臣之甚，許以公庭獲展私敬。

translations.literal: Later Emperor Wen ordered Xuangan lowered one rank; Xuangan bowed in thanks and said: "I did not expect Your Majesty to favor your subject so — permitting him to show private respect in the public hall.
translations.idiomatic: Later Emperor Wen ordered Xuangan lowered one rank. Xuangan bowed in thanks and said, "I did not expect Your Majesty to favor your subject so — permitting him to show private respect in the public hall.

sentences.zh: 」初拜郢州刺史，到官潛布耳目，察長吏能不，纖介必知，吏人敬服，皆稱其能。

translations.literal: " When first appointed Regional Inspector of Yingzhou, he secretly deployed informants to observe whether chief officials were capable; the slightest detail he always knew; officials and people respected and submitted, all calling him able.
translations.idiomatic: " When first appointed Regional Inspector of Yingzhou, he secretly deployed informants to observe whether chief officials were capable. The slightest detail he always knew; officials and people respected and submitted, all calling him able.

sentences.zh: 後轉宋州刺史，父憂去職。

translations.literal: Later he was transferred to Regional Inspector of Songzhou and left office for his father's mourning.
translations.idiomatic: In time, later he was transferred to Regional Inspector of Songzhou and left office for his father's mourning.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，拜鴻臚卿，襲爵楚公，遷禮部尚書。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was appointed Superintendent of Dependencies, inherited the title Duke of Chu, and was transferred to Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Inherited the title Duke of Chu, and was transferred to Minister of Rites, and after more than a year he was appointed Superintendent of Dependencies.

sentences.zh: 性雖驕居，而愛重文學，四海知名之士多趨其門。

translations.literal: Although his nature was proud in station, he valued and honored literature; renowned scholars from within the four seas mostly flocked to his gate.
translations.idiomatic: Although his nature was proud in station, he valued and honored literature. Renowned scholars from within the four seas mostly flocked to his gate.

sentences.zh: 後見朝綱漸紊，帝又猜忌日甚，內不自安，遂與諸弟潛謀廢帝立秦王浩。

translations.literal: Later seeing court discipline gradually disordered and the emperor's suspicion growing daily, he felt insecure within and therefore secretly plotted with his brothers to depose the emperor and install the Prince of Qin, Hao.
translations.idiomatic: He felt insecure within and therefore secretly plotted with his brothers to depose the emperor and install the Prince of Qin, Hao, and later seeing court discipline gradually disordered and the emperor's suspicion growing daily.

sentences.zh: 及從征吐谷渾，還至達鬥拔谷，時從官狼狽，玄感欲襲擊行宮。

translations.literal: When he followed the campaign against Tuyuhun and returned to Databo Valley, the accompanying officials were in disarray and Xuangan wished to strike the traveling palace.
translations.idiomatic: The accompanying officials were in disarray and Xuangan wished to strike the traveling palace, and when he followed the campaign against Tuyuhun and returned to Databo Valley.

sentences.zh: 其叔慎曰：「士心尚一，國未有釁，不可圖也。

translations.literal: His uncle Shen said: "The soldiers' hearts are still united and the state has no opening — it cannot be plotted.
translations.idiomatic: His uncle Shen said, "The soldiers' hearts are still united and the state has no opening — it cannot be plotted.

sentences.zh: 」玄感乃止。

translations.literal: " Xuangan thereupon desisted.
translations.idiomatic: " Xuangan held back.

sentences.zh: 時帝好征伐，玄感欲立威名，陰求將領，以告兵部尚書段文振。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor loved campaigns; Xuangan wished to establish a martial reputation and secretly sought a command, telling Minister of the Seven Arms Duan Wenzhen.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the emperor loved campaigns. Xuangan wished to establish a martial reputation and secretly sought a command, telling Minister of the Seven Arms Duan Wenzhen.

sentences.zh: 振以白帝，帝嘉之，謂群臣曰：「將門有將，故不虛也。

translations.literal: Wenzhen reported this to the emperor; the emperor approved and told the assembled ministers: "A general's house produces generals — it is not empty praise.
translations.idiomatic: Wenzhen reported this to the emperor. The emperor approved and told the assembled ministers, "A general's house produces generals — it is not empty praise.

sentences.zh: 」於是賚物千段，禮遇益隆，頗預朝政。

translations.literal: " He was therefore granted a thousand lengths of goods, his courtesy and favor grew ever greater, and he took considerable part in court governance.
translations.idiomatic: His courtesy and favor grew ever greater, and he took considerable part in court governance, and " He was therefore granted a thousand lengths of goods.

sentences.zh: 帝征遼東，令玄感黎陽督運。

translations.literal: When the emperor campaigned against Liaodong he ordered Xuangan to supervise transport at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: Once the emperor campaigned against Liaodong he ordered Xuangan to supervise transport at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 遂與武賁郎將王仲伯、汲郡贊治趙懷義等謀，不時進發。

translations.literal: He then plotted with Palace Guard Gentleman Wang Zhongbo, Assistant Administrator of Ji Commandery Zhao Huaiyi, and others not to advance on schedule.
translations.idiomatic: Next he plotted with Palace Guard Gentleman Wang Zhongbo, Assistant Administrator of Ji Commandery Zhao Huaiyi, and others not to advance on schedule.

sentences.zh: 帝遣使者逼促，玄感揚言曰：「水路多盜，不可前後而發。

translations.literal: The emperor sent envoys to press him; Xuangan proclaimed: "There are many bandits on the water route — one cannot send ships out front and rear together.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent envoys to press him. Xuangan proclaimed, "There are many bandits on the water route — one cannot send ships out front and rear together.

sentences.zh: 」其弟武賁郎將玄縱、鷹揚郎將萬石並從幸遼東，玄感潛遣人召之。

translations.literal: " His younger brothers Palace Guard Gentleman Xuanzong and Feathered Guard Gentleman Wanshi were both accompanying the emperor in Liaodong; Xuangan secretly sent men to summon them.
translations.idiomatic: " His younger brothers Palace Guard Gentleman Xuanzong and Feathered Guard Gentleman Wanshi were both accompanying the emperor in Liaodong. Xuangan secretly sent men to summon them.

sentences.zh: 時來護兒以舟師自東萊，將入海趣平壤城，軍未發。

translations.literal: At that time Lai Huer with the fleet from Donglai was about to enter the sea and hurry to Pyongyang; the army had not yet set out.
translations.idiomatic: In time, at that time Lai Huer with the fleet from Donglai was about to enter the sea and hurry to Pyongyang; the army had not yet set out.

sentences.zh: 玄感無以動眾，乃遣家奴偽為使，從東方來，謬稱護失軍期而反。

translations.literal: Xuangan had no means to move the masses; he therefore sent a household slave disguised as an envoy from the east falsely claiming Huer had missed the campaign deadline and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan had no means to move the masses. He therefore sent a household slave disguised as an envoy from the east falsely claiming Huer had missed the campaign deadline and returned.

sentences.zh: 玄感遂入黎陽縣，閉城大募勇夫。

translations.literal: Xuangan then entered Liyang County, closed the gates, and greatly recruited brave men.
translations.idiomatic: Closed the gates, and greatly recruited brave men, and xuangan then entered Liyang County.

sentences.zh: 於是取颿布為牟甲，署置官屬皆准開皇之舊。

translations.literal: Thereupon sailcloth was taken for armor and officials were appointed all according to the Kaihuang precedent.
translations.idiomatic: At that point sailcloth was taken for armor and officials were appointed all according to the Kaihuang precedent.

sentences.zh: 移書傍郡以討護為名，令發兵會於倉所。

translations.literal: He sent letters to neighboring commanderies in the name of punishing Huer, ordering them to send troops to assemble at the granary.
translations.idiomatic: Ordering them to send troops to assemble at the granary, and he sent letters to neighboring commanderies in the name of punishing Huer.

sentences.zh: 以東光縣尉元務本為黎州刺史，趙懷義為衛州刺史，河內郡主簿唐禕為懷州刺史，有眾且一萬，將襲洛陽。

translations.literal: He made Dongguang County Magistrate Yuan Wuben Regional Inspector of Li, Zhao Huaiyi Regional Inspector of Wei, and Chief Clerk of Henei Commandery Tang Yi Regional Inspector of Huai; with troops numbering nearly ten thousand he was about to strike Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: He made Dongguang County Magistrate Yuan Wuben Regional Inspector of Li, Zhao Huaiyi Regional Inspector of Wei, and Chief Clerk of Henei Commandery Tang Yi Regional Inspector of Huai. With troops numbering nearly ten thousand he was about to strike Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 唐禕至河內，馳往東都告之。

translations.literal: When Tang Yi reached Henei he galloped to the eastern capital to report it.
translations.idiomatic: After Tang Yi reached Henei he galloped to the eastern capital to report it.

sentences.zh: 越王侗、戶部尚書樊子蓋等勒兵備禦。

translations.literal: The Prince of Yue, Tong, Minister of Revenue Fan Zigai, and others mustered troops to prepare defense.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Yue, Tong, Minister of Revenue Fan Zigai, ; others mustered troops to prepare defense.

sentences.zh: 修武縣人相率守臨清關，玄感不得濟，遂于汲郡南度河。

translations.literal: People of Xiuwu County together held Linqing Pass; Xuangan could not cross and therefore crossed the river south of Ji Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: People of Xiuwu County together held Linqing Pass. Xuangan could not cross and therefore crossed the river south of Ji Commandery.

sentences.zh: 從亂如市，數日，屯兵上春門，眾至十餘萬。

translations.literal: Those who followed the rebellion were like a market; within days he encamped at Shangchun Gate with masses reaching more than a hundred thousand.
translations.idiomatic: Those who followed the rebellion were like a market. Within days he encamped at Shangchun Gate with masses reaching more than a hundred thousand.

sentences.zh: 子蓋令河南贊務裴弘策拒之，弘策戰敗，父老競致牛酒。

translations.literal: Zigai ordered Henan Assistant Administrator Pei Hongce to resist him; Hongce was defeated in battle and elders competed to bring oxen and wine.
translations.idiomatic: Zigai ordered Henan Assistant Administrator Pei Hongce to resist him. Hongce was defeated in battle and elders competed to bring oxen and wine.

sentences.zh: 玄感屯兵尚書省，每有誓眾曰：「我身為上柱國，家累巨萬金，至富貴，無所求也。

translations.literal: Xuangan encamped at the Imperial Secretariat; whenever he rallied the masses he said: "I personally am a Superior Pillar of State; my household accumulates tens of thousands in gold — I have reached utmost wealth and rank and seek nothing.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan encamped at the Imperial Secretariat. Whenever he rallied the masses he said, "I personally am a Superior Pillar of State. My household accumulates tens of thousands in gold — I have reached utmost wealth and rank and seek nothing.

sentences.zh: 今者不顧破家滅族者，為天下解倒懸之急，救黎元之命耳。

translations.literal: Today I disregard the destruction of house and clan because the realm hangs upside down in urgent peril and the lives of the people must be saved.
translations.idiomatic: In time, today I disregard the destruction of house and clan because the realm hangs upside down in urgent peril and the lives of the people must be saved.

sentences.zh: 」眾皆悅，詣轅門請自效者日數千。

translations.literal: " The masses were all pleased; those who came to the camp gate daily requesting to serve numbered in the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In time, " The masses were all pleased; those who came to the camp gate daily requesting to serve numbered in the thousands.

sentences.zh: 及與樊子蓋書曰：

translations.literal: He also wrote to Fan Zigai, saying:
translations.idiomatic: He likewise wrote to Fan Zigai, saying:

sentences.zh: 夫建忠立義，事有多途，見機而作，蓋非一揆。

translations.literal: To establish loyalty and righteousness there are many paths; to seize the moment and act is surely not one single measure.
translations.idiomatic: In time, to establish loyalty and righteousness there are many paths; to seize the moment and act is surely not one single measure.

sentences.zh: 昔伊尹放太甲于桐宮，霍光廢劉賀於昌邑，此並公度內，不能一二披陳。

translations.literal: In old times Yi Yin placed Emperor Taijia in the Tong Palace and Huo Guang deposed Liu He at Changyi — these were within public duty and cannot be fully set forth one by one.
translations.idiomatic: In time, in old times Yi Yin placed Emperor Taijia in the Tong Palace and Huo Guang deposed Liu He at Changyi — these were within public duty and cannot be fully set forth one by one.

sentences.zh: 高祖文皇帝誕膺天命，造茲區宇，在ＦＭ璣以齊七政，握金鏡以馭六龍，無為而至化流，垂拱而天下乂。

translations.literal: Emperor Wen, the Founding Emperor, received Heaven's Mandate and created this realm; holding the armillary sphere to align the seven regulators, grasping the golden mirror to rein the six dragons — through non-action transformation flowed, with folded hands the realm was at peace.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen, the Founding Emperor, received Heaven's Mandate and created this realm. Holding the armillary sphere to align the seven regulators, grasping the golden mirror to rein the six dragons — through non-action transformation flowed, with folded hands the realm was at peace.

sentences.zh: 今上纂承寶曆，宜固洪基，乃自絕於天，殄人敗德。

translations.literal: The present ruler has succeeded to the precious succession and should consolidate the great foundation, yet he has cut himself off from Heaven and destroyed people and ruined virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he has cut himself off from Heaven and destroyed people and ruined virtue, and the present ruler has succeeded to the precious succession and should consolidate the great foundation.

sentences.zh: 頻年肆眚，盜賤於是滋多；

translations.literal: Year after year he has issued amnesties while bandits and thieves have thus multiplied;
translations.idiomatic: Year after year he has issued amnesties while bandits while thieves have thus multiplied;

sentences.zh: 所在修營，人力為之凋盡。

translations.literal: wherever construction is undertaken human strength is exhausted for it.
translations.idiomatic: wherever construction is undertaken, human strength is worn to the bone.

sentences.zh: 荒淫酒色，子女必被其侵；

translations.literal: Indulging in debauchery, wine, and women — daughters must suffer his violation;
translations.idiomatic: Indulging in debauchery, wine, ; women — daughters must suffer his violation;

sentences.zh: 耽玩鷹犬，禽獸皆離其毒。

translations.literal: addicted to hawks and dogs — birds and beasts all suffer his cruelty.
translations.idiomatic: In time, addicted to hawks and dogs — birds and beasts all suffer his cruelty.

sentences.zh: 朋黨相扇，貸賄公行，納邪佞之言，杜正直之口。

translations.literal: Factions fan one another; bribes walk openly; wicked and flattering words are admitted while straight and upright mouths are stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Factions fan one another; bribes walk openly; wicked while flattering words are admitted while straight while upright mouths are stopped.

sentences.zh: 加以轉輸不息，徭役無期；

translations.literal: Added to this, transport and relay labor never cease and corvée has no fixed term;
translations.idiomatic: In time, added to this, transport and relay labor never cease and corvée has no fixed term;

sentences.zh: 士卒填溝壑，骸骨蔽原野；

translations.literal: soldiers fill ditches and gullies and bones cover the open fields;
translations.idiomatic: In time, soldiers fill ditches and gullies and bones cover the open fields;

sentences.zh: 黃河之北則千里無煙，江、淮之間則鞠為茂草。

translations.literal: north of the Yellow River for a thousand li there is no smoke; between the Yangtze and Huai the land has become wild grass.
translations.idiomatic: In time, north of the Yellow River for a thousand li there is no smoke; between the Yangtze and Huai the land has become wild grass.

sentences.zh: 玄感世荷國恩，位居上將。

translations.literal: Xuangan has for generations received the state's grace and holds the rank of supreme general.
translations.idiomatic: In time, xuangan has for generations received the state's grace and holds the rank of supreme general.

sentences.zh: 先公奉遺詔曰：「好子孫為我輔弼之，惡子孫為我屏黜之。

translations.literal: My late father received the deathbed edict: "Take good descendants as my assistants; remove wicked descendants as my outcasts.
translations.idiomatic: In time, my late father received the deathbed edict: "Take good descendants as my assistants; remove wicked descendants as my outcasts.

sentences.zh: 」所以上稟先旨，下順人心，廢此淫昏，更立明哲。

translations.literal: " Therefore above I carry out the former command and below I follow the people's hearts — deposing this debauched fool and installing another wise and enlightened ruler.
translations.idiomatic: In time, " Therefore above I carry out the former command and below I follow the people's hearts — deposing this debauched fool and installing another wise and enlightened ruler.

sentences.zh: 今四海同心，九有咸應，士卒用命，如赴私仇，人庶相趨，義形公道。

translations.literal: Now the four seas share one heart and the nine regions all respond; soldiers obey orders as if answering a private feud and people and masses hurry together with righteousness shown in the public way.
translations.idiomatic: Now the four seas share one heart and the nine regions all respond. Soldiers obey orders as if answering a private feud and people and masses hurry together with righteousness shown in the public way.

sentences.zh: 天意人事，較然可知。

translations.literal: Heaven's intent and human affairs are clearly knowable.
translations.idiomatic: In time, heaven's intent and human affairs are clearly knowable.

sentences.zh: 公獨害孤城，勢何支久？

translations.literal: You alone harm this isolated city — how long can your strength last?
translations.idiomatic: You alone hold out in this isolated city — how long can your strength last?

sentences.zh: 願以黔黎在念，社稷為心，勿拘小禮，自貽伊戚。

translations.literal: I hope you will keep the black-haired masses in mind and the altars of state in your heart; do not cling to small rites and bring calamity upon yourself.
translations.idiomatic: I hope you will keep the black-haired masses in mind and the altars of state in your heart. Do not cling to small rites and bring calamity upon yourself.

sentences.zh: 誰謂國家，一旦至此！

translations.literal: Who would have thought the state would come to this in a single day!
translations.idiomatic: In time, who would have thought the state would come to this in a single day!

sentences.zh: 執筆潸然，言無所具。

translations.literal: Taking up the brush I weep; words cannot say all.
translations.idiomatic: In time, taking up the brush I weep; words cannot say all.

sentences.zh: 遂進逼東都城。

translations.literal: He then advanced and pressed the eastern capital city.
translations.idiomatic: Next he advanced and pressed the eastern capital city.

sentences.zh: 刑部尚書衛玄率眾自關中來援東都，以步騎二萬度瀍、澗挑戰。

translations.literal: Minister of Punishments Wei Xuan led troops from Guanzhong to aid the eastern capital and with twenty thousand infantry and cavalry crossed Chan and Jian to offer battle.
translations.idiomatic: In time, minister of Punishments Wei Xuan led troops from Guanzhong to aid the eastern capital and with twenty thousand infantry and cavalry crossed Chan and Jian to offer battle.

sentences.zh: 玄感偽北，玄逐之，伏兵發，前軍盡沒。

translations.literal: Xuangan feigned a retreat north; Xuan pursued and ambush troops sprang up — the vanguard was entirely destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan feigned a retreat north. Xuan pursued and ambush troops sprang up — the vanguard was entirely destroyed.

sentences.zh: 後數日，玄復與玄感戰。

translations.literal: Several days later Xuan again fought Xuangan.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later Xuan fought Xuangan again.

sentences.zh: 兵始合，玄感詐令人大呼曰：「官軍已得玄感矣。

translations.literal: As the armies first joined Xuangan had men shout loudly: "The government army has already captured Xuangan!
translations.idiomatic: As the armies first joined Xuangan had men shout loudly, "The government army has already captured Xuangan!

sentences.zh: 」玄軍稍怠，玄感與數千騎乘之，大潰，擁八千人而去。

translations.literal: " Xuan's army slackened slightly; Xuangan with several thousand horsemen charged them and they broke utterly, driving off eight thousand men.
translations.idiomatic: " Xuan's army slackened slightly. Xuangan with several thousand horsemen charged them and they broke utterly, driving off eight thousand men.

sentences.zh: 玄感驍勇多力，每戰，親運長矛，身先士卒，喑鳴叱吒，所當莫不震懾，論者方之項羽。

translations.literal: Xuangan was fierce, brave, and strong; in every battle he personally wielded a long spear, led from the front, and with shouts and roars none who faced him failed to be shaken — commentators compared him to Xiang Yu.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan was fierce, brave, and strong. In every battle he personally wielded a long spear, led from the front, and with shouts and roars none who faced him failed to be shaken — commentators compared him to Xiang Yu.

sentences.zh: 又善撫馭，士樂致死。

translations.literal: He was also skilled at winning men; soldiers gladly died for him.
translations.idiomatic: He also knew how to win men's hearts; soldiers gladly died for him.

sentences.zh: 由是戰無不捷。

translations.literal: Therefore in battle he was never defeated.
translations.idiomatic: In battle he was never once defeated.

sentences.zh: 玄軍日蹙，糧又盡，乃悉眾決戰，陣於北邙，一日間戰十餘合。

translations.literal: Xuan's army was pressed daily and grain was exhausted; he therefore gathered all his forces for a decisive battle and deployed on Mount Beimang — in one day they fought more than ten engagements.
translations.idiomatic: Xuan's army was pressed daily and grain was exhausted. He therefore gathered all his forces for a decisive battle and deployed on Mount Beimang — in one day they fought more than ten engagements.

sentences.zh: 玄感弟玄挺中流矢而斃，玄感稍卻。

translations.literal: Xuangan's younger brother Xuanting was struck by a flying arrow and died; Xuangan withdrew slightly.
translations.idiomatic: In time, xuangan's younger brother Xuanting was struck by a flying arrow and died; Xuangan withdrew slightly.

sentences.zh: 樊子蓋復遣兵攻尚書省，又殺數百人。

translations.literal: Fan Zigai again sent troops to attack the Imperial Secretariat and killed several hundred more.
translations.idiomatic: In time, fan Zigai again sent troops to attack the Imperial Secretariat and killed several hundred more.

sentences.zh: 帝遣武賁郎將陳稜攻元務本于黎陽。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Palace Guard Gentleman Chen Leng to attack Yuan Wuben at Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: The ruler sent Palace Guard Gentleman Chen Leng to attack Yuan Wuben at Liyang.

sentences.zh: 武衛將軍屈突通屯河陽，左翊衛大將軍宇文述發兵繼進，右驍衛大將軍來護兒復來趙援。

translations.literal: Guard General Qu Tu Tong encamped at Heyang; Left Guard Grand General Yuwen Shu set out with troops in support; Right Agile Guard Grand General Lai Huer also came from Zhao to aid.
translations.idiomatic: Guard General Qu Tu Tong encamped at Heyang; Left Guard Grand General Yuwen Shu set out with troops in support; Right Agile Guard Grand General Lai Huer likewise came from Zhao to aid.

sentences.zh: 玄感與前戶部尚書李子雄計曰：「屈突通曉兵事，若度河則勝負難決，不如分兵拒之。

translations.literal: Xuangan plotted with former Minister of Revenue Li Zixiong, saying: "Qu Tu Tong understands military affairs; if he crosses the river victory and defeat will be hard to decide — better to divide troops to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan plotted with former Minister of Revenue Li Zixiong, saying, "Qu Tu Tong understands military affairs. If he crosses the river victory and defeat will be hard to decide — better to divide troops to resist him.

sentences.zh: 不能濟，則樊、衛失援。

translations.literal: If he cannot cross, then Fan and Wei lose support.
translations.idiomatic: Then Fan and Wei lose support, and if he cannot cross.

sentences.zh: 」玄感然之，將拒通。

translations.literal: " Xuangan agreed and was about to resist Tong.
translations.idiomatic: In time, " Xuangan agreed and was about to resist Tong.

sentences.zh: 子蓋知其謀，數擊其營，玄感不果進。

translations.literal: Zigai learned of the plan and repeatedly struck his camps; Xuangan could not advance.
translations.idiomatic: In time, zigai learned of the plan and repeatedly struck his camps; Xuangan could not advance.

sentences.zh: 通遂濟河，軍於破陵。

translations.literal: Tong thereupon crossed the river and encamped at Poling.
translations.idiomatic: Tong at that point crossed the river and encamped at Poling.

sentences.zh: 玄感為兩軍，西拒衛玄，東拒屈突通。

translations.literal: Xuangan divided into two armies, resisting Wei Xuan in the west and Qu Tu Tong in the east.
translations.idiomatic: Resisting Wei Xuan in the west and Qu Tu Tong in the east, and xuangan divided into two armies.

sentences.zh: 子蓋復出兵大戰，玄感軍頻北。

translations.literal: Zigai again sent troops for a great battle; Xuangan's army repeatedly fled north.
translations.idiomatic: In time, zigai again sent troops for a great battle; Xuangan's army repeatedly fled north.

sentences.zh: 復與子雄計，子雄勸之直入關中，開永豐倉振貧乏，三輔可指麾而定。

translations.literal: He again plotted with Zixiong; Zixiong urged him to enter Guanzhong directly, open the Yongfeng granary to relieve the poor, and the three auxiliary regions could be taken at a gesture.
translations.idiomatic: He again plotted with Zixiong. Zixiong urged him to enter Guanzhong directly, open the Yongfeng granary to relieve the poor, and the three auxiliary regions could be taken at a gesture.

sentences.zh: 據有府庫，東面而爭天下，此亦霸王之業。

translations.literal: Holding the storehouses and treasuries and contending for the realm facing east — this too is an enterprise of hegemony.
translations.idiomatic: In time, holding the storehouses and treasuries and contending for the realm facing east — this too is an enterprise of hegemony.

sentences.zh: 會華陰諸楊請為鄉導，玄感遂釋洛陽，西圖關中。

translations.literal: When the Yang clan of Huayin requested to serve as local guides Xuangan thereupon abandoned Luoyang and turned west toward Guanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: Once the Yang clan of Huayin requested to serve as local guides Xuangan thereupon abandoned Luoyang and turned west toward Guanzhong.

sentences.zh: 宣言已破東都，取關西。

translations.literal: He proclaimed he had already broken the eastern capital and was taking the western passes.
translations.idiomatic: In time, he proclaimed he had already broken the eastern capital and was taking the western passes.

sentences.zh: 宇文述等諸軍躡之。

translations.literal: Yuwen Shu and the other armies pursued him.
translations.idiomatic: In time, yuwen Shu and the other armies pursued him.

sentences.zh: 至弘農宮，父老遮說玄感曰：「宮城空虛，又多積粟，攻之易下。

translations.literal: At Hongnong Palace the elders blocked the way and advised Xuangan: "The palace city is empty and grain is greatly stored — attacking it is easy to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: At Hongnong Palace the elders blocked the way and advised Xuangan, "The palace city is empty and grain is greatly stored — attacking it is easy to succeed.

sentences.zh: 進可絕敵人之食，退可割宜陽之地。

translations.literal: Advancing you can cut off the enemy's food; retreating you can seize the land of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In time, advancing you can cut off the enemy's food; retreating you can seize the land of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 」玄感以為然，留攻三日，城不下，追兵遂至。

translations.literal: " Xuangan thought this correct and stayed to attack for three days; the city did not fall and pursuing troops arrived.
translations.idiomatic: " Xuangan thought this correct and stayed to attack for three days. The city did not fall and pursuing troops arrived.

sentences.zh: 玄感西至閿鄉，上槃豆，佈陣亙五十里，與官軍且戰且行，一日三敗。

translations.literal: Xuangan went west to Wen Township and ascended Pandou, deploying formations stretching fifty li; with the government army he fought while marching and was defeated three times in one day.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan went west to Wen Township and ascended Pandou, deploying formations stretching fifty li. With the government army he fought while marching and was defeated three times in one day.

sentences.zh: 復陣于董杜原，諸軍大敗之。

translations.literal: He deployed again at Dongdu Plain and the various armies utterly defeated him.
translations.idiomatic: In time, he deployed again at Dongdu Plain and the various armies utterly defeated him.

sentences.zh: 玄感獨與十餘騎竄林木間，將奔上洛。

translations.literal: Xuangan alone with more than ten horsemen fled into the forest and trees, about to escape to Shangluo.
translations.idiomatic: About to escape to Shangluo, and xuangan alone with more than ten horsemen fled into the forest and trees.

sentences.zh: 追騎至，玄感叱之，皆懼而返走。

translations.literal: Pursuing horsemen arrived; Xuangan shouted at them and all feared and turned back.
translations.idiomatic: In time, pursuing horsemen arrived; Xuangan shouted at them and all feared and turned back.

sentences.zh: 至葭蘆戍，窘迫，獨與弟積善步行，謂積善曰：「事敗矣，我不能受人戮辱，汝可殺我。

translations.literal: At Jialu Post, hard pressed, alone with his younger brother Jishan on foot, he said to Jishan: "It is finished — I cannot suffer the humiliation of being executed by others; you may kill me.
translations.idiomatic: At Jialu Post, hard pressed, alone with his younger brother Jishan on foot, he said to Jishan, "It is finished — I cannot suffer the humiliation of being executed by others; you may kill me.

sentences.zh: 」積善殺之，因自刺不死，為追兵所執，與玄感首俱送行在所，磔其屍於東都市，三日，復臠而焚之。

translations.literal: " Jishan killed him, then stabbed himself but did not die and was seized by pursuing troops; together with Xuangan's head he was sent to the imperial presence; the corpse was dismembered at the eastern market, and after three days was minced and burned.
translations.idiomatic: " Jishan killed him, then stabbed himself but did not die and was seized by pursuing troops. Together with Xuangan's head he was sent to the imperial presence. The corpse was dismembered at the eastern market, and after three days was minced and burned.

sentences.zh: 餘黨悉平。

translations.literal: The remaining factions were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: The remaining rebels were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 其弟玄獎為義陽太守，將歸玄感，為郡丞周旋玉所殺。
