translations.literal: His younger brother Xuanjiang was Grand Administrator of Yiyang and was about to join Xuangan; he was killed by Assistant Administrator Zhou Xuanyu.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Xuanjiang was Grand Administrator of Yiyang and was about to join Xuangan. He was killed by Assistant Administrator Zhou Xuanyu.

sentences.zh: 玄縱弟萬石，自帝所逃歸，至高陽，止傳舍，監事許華與郡兵執之，斬於涿郡。

translations.literal: Xuanzong's younger brother Wanshi fled from the emperor's camp, reached Gaoyang, and stopped at a relay station; Supervisor Xu Hua together with commandery troops seized him and beheaded him at Zhuo Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Xuanzong's younger brother Wanshi fled from the emperor's camp, reached Gaoyang, and stopped at a relay station. Supervisor Xu Hua together with commandery troops seized him and beheaded him at Zhuo Commandery.

sentences.zh: 萬石弟仁行，官至朝議大夫，斬于長安。

translations.literal: Wanshi's younger brother Renxing, who had reached the post of Remonstrance and Criticism Grandee, was beheaded at Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: Who had reached the post of Remonstrance and Criticism Grandee, was beheaded at Chang'an, and wanshi's younger brother Renxing.

sentences.zh: 並具梟磔。

translations.literal: All were fully dismembered and exposed.
translations.idiomatic: In time, all were fully dismembered and exposed.

sentences.zh: 公卿請改玄感姓為梟氏，詔可之。

translations.literal: The dukes and ministers requested that Xuangan's surname be changed to the Xiao clan; an edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: The dukes and ministers requested that Xuangan's surname be changed to the Xiao clan. An edict approved this.

sentences.zh: 玄感之亂，有趙元淑者預謀，誅。

translations.literal: In Xuangan's rebellion there was one Zhao Yuanshu who took part in the plot; he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuangan's rebellion there was one Zhao Yuanshu who took part in the plot. He was executed.

sentences.zh: 又有劉元進，亦舉兵應之。

translations.literal: There was also Liu Yuanjin who likewise raised troops in response.
translations.idiomatic: There was likewise Liu Yuanjin who likewise raised troops in response.

sentences.zh: 元淑，博陵人。

translations.literal: Yuanshu was a man of Boling.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshu came from Boling.

sentences.zh: 父世模，初從高寶，後以眾歸周，授上開府，寓居京兆之雲陽。

translations.literal: His father Shimo at first followed Gao Bao, then with his troops submitted to Zhou and was granted Senior Grand Master of the Palace; he resided at Yunyang in Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shimo at first followed Gao Bao, then with his troops submitted to Zhou and was granted Senior Grand Master of the Palace. He resided at Yunyang in Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝踐阼，恆典宿衛。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui ascended the throne he regularly performed palace guard duty.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Wen of Sui ascended the throne he regularly performed palace guard duty.

sentences.zh: 後從晉王伐陳，力戰而死。

translations.literal: Later he followed the Prince of Jin in campaigning against Chen and died fighting fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: In time, later he followed the Prince of Jin in campaigning against Chen and died fighting fiercely.

sentences.zh: 朝廷以其身死王事，以元淑襲父本官，賜物三千段。

translations.literal: The court, because he died in the prince's service, had Yuanshu inherit his father's original post and granted three thousand lengths of goods.
translations.idiomatic: In time, the court, because he died in the prince's service, had Yuanshu inherit his father's original post and granted three thousand lengths of goods.

sentences.zh: 元淑性疏誕，不事產業，家徒壁立。

translations.literal: Yuanshu's nature was bold and unrestrained; he did not attend to estates and his household was bare as a wall.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshu's nature was bold and unrestrained. He did not attend to estates and his household was bare as a wall.

sentences.zh: 後授驃騎將軍，將之官，無以自給。

translations.literal: Later he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry and was about to take up his post but had no means to support himself.
translations.idiomatic: In time, later he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry and was about to take up his post but had no means to support himself.

sentences.zh: 時長安富人宗連家累千金，仕周為三原令，有季女，慧而有色。

translations.literal: At that time the rich man Zong Lian of Chang'an had household wealth of a thousand gold; he had served Zhou as Magistrate of Sanyuan and had a youngest daughter, clever and beautiful.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the rich man Zong Lian of Chang'an had household wealth of a thousand gold. He had served Zhou as Magistrate of Sanyuan and had a youngest daughter, clever and beautiful.

sentences.zh: 連每求賢夫，聞元淑，請與相見。

translations.literal: Lian repeatedly sought a worthy son-in-law; hearing of Yuanshu he requested a meeting.
translations.idiomatic: Lian repeatedly sought a worthy son-in-law. Hearing of Yuanshu he requested a meeting.

sentences.zh: 連有風儀，美談笑，元淑亦慕之。

translations.literal: Lian had bearing and grace and spoke elegantly; Yuanshu also admired him.
translations.idiomatic: Lian had bearing and grace and spoke elegantly. Yuanshu also admired him.

sentences.zh: 及至其家，服玩居處，擬於將相，酒酣，奏女樂，元淑所未見也。

translations.literal: When he reached his home, clothing, playthings, dwelling, and surroundings rivaled those of generals and ministers; when wine was warm female musicians performed — Yuanshu had never seen the like.
translations.idiomatic: When he reached his home, clothing, playthings, dwelling, and surroundings rivaled those of generals and ministers. When wine was warm female musicians performed — Yuanshu had never seen the like.

sentences.zh: 及出，連又致殷勤。

translations.literal: When he left, Lian again showed great courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: As he departed, Lian again showed great courtesy.

sentences.zh: 元淑再三來，宴樂更侈於前。

translations.literal: Yuanshu came again and again; banquets and music were more lavish than before.
translations.idiomatic: In time, yuanshu came again and again; banquets and music were more lavish than before.

sentences.zh: 因問所須，盡買與之，元淑致謝，連復拜求以女妻之。

translations.literal: He therefore asked what was needed and bought everything for him; Yuanshu thanked him and Lian again bowed and requested his daughter as wife.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore asked what was needed and bought everything for him. Yuanshu thanked him and Lian again bowed and requested his daughter as wife.

sentences.zh: 元淑感而納焉，遂為富人。

translations.literal: Yuanshu was moved and accepted her; he thereupon became a rich man.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshu was moved and accepted her; he at that point became a rich man.

sentences.zh: 從楊素平楊諒，以功進位柱國，曆德州刺史、潁川太守，並有威惠。

translations.literal: Following Yang Su in pacifying Yang Liang, for merit he was advanced to Pillar of State and served as Regional Inspector of Dezhou and Grand Administrator of Yingchuan — all with authority and kindness.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was advanced to Pillar of State and served as Regional Inspector of Dezhou and Grand Administrator of Yingchuan — all with authority and kindness, and following Yang Su in pacifying Yang Liang.

sentences.zh: 入為司農卿。

translations.literal: He entered court as Minister of Agriculture.
translations.idiomatic: He took office as Minister of Agriculture.

sentences.zh: 玄感有異志，遂與結交。

translations.literal: Xuangan had rebellious intent; he therefore formed a friendship with him.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan had rebellious intent; he for this reason formed a friendship with him.

sentences.zh: 遼東之役，領將軍、典宿衛，加光祿大夫，封葛國公。

translations.literal: In the Liaodong campaign he held the post of general and supervised palace guard, with the added title Grand Master of Splendor and enfeoffment as Duke of Ge.
translations.idiomatic: With the added title Grand Master of Splendor and enfeoffment as Duke of Ge, and in the Liaodong campaign he held the post of general and supervised palace guard.

sentences.zh: 明年，帝復征高麗，以元淑鎮監渝。

translations.literal: The next year the emperor again campaigned against Goryeo and made Yuanshu guard and supervise Linyu.
translations.idiomatic: In time, the next year the emperor again campaigned against Goryeo and made Yuanshu guard and supervise Linyu.

sentences.zh: 及玄感作亂，其弟玄縱自駕所逃歸，路經臨渝。

translations.literal: When Xuangan rebelled, his younger brother Xuanzong fled from the imperial camp; on the road he passed Linyu.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuangan rebelled, his younger brother Xuanzong fled from the imperial camp. On the road he passed Linyu.

sentences.zh: 元淑出其小妻魏氏見玄縱，對宴極歡，因與通謀，並受玄縱賂遺。

translations.literal: Yuanshu brought out his concubine Lady Wei to meet Xuanzong; they feasted together with utmost joy and therefore plotted together, and Yuanshu also received bribes from Xuanzong.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanshu brought out his concubine Lady Wei to meet Xuanzong. They feasted together with utmost joy and therefore plotted together, and Yuanshu also received bribes from Xuanzong.

sentences.zh: 及玄感敗，人有告其事者，帝以屬吏，元淑及魏氏俱斬於涿郡，籍沒其家。

translations.literal: When Xuangan was defeated someone reported the matter; the emperor handed him to the officials and Yuanshu and Lady Wei were both beheaded at Zhuo Commandery; their household was confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: When Xuangan was defeated someone reported the matter. The emperor handed him to the officials and Yuanshu and Lady Wei were both beheaded at Zhuo Commandery. Their household was confiscated.

sentences.zh: 元進，余杭人。

translations.literal: Yuanjin was a man of Yuhang.
translations.idiomatic: Yuanjin came from Yuhang.

sentences.zh: 少好任俠，為州裏所宗，兩手各長尺餘，臂垂過膝。

translations.literal: From youth he loved chivalry and was honored by his district; each hand was more than a chi long and his arms hung past his knees.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he loved chivalry and was honored by his district. Each hand was more than a chi long and his arms hung past his knees.

sentences.zh: 屬遼東之役，百姓騷動，元進自以相表非常，遂聚亡命。

translations.literal: During the Liaodong campaign the people were in turmoil; Yuanjin considered his physiognomy extraordinary and therefore gathered fugitives.
translations.idiomatic: During the Liaodong campaign the people were in turmoil. Yuanjin considered his physiognomy extraordinary and therefore gathered fugitives.

sentences.zh: 會玄感起于黎陽，元進應之。

translations.literal: When Xuangan rose at Liyang, Yuanjin responded to him.
translations.idiomatic: Once Xuangan rose at Liyang, Yuanjin responded to him.

sentences.zh: 旬月，眾至數萬，將度江而玄感敗。

translations.literal: Within a month his masses reached tens of thousands; he was about to cross the Yangtze when Xuangan was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Within a month his masses reached tens of thousands. He was about to cross the Yangtze when Xuangan was defeated.

sentences.zh: 吳郡硃燮、晉陵管崇亦舉兵，有眾七萬，共迎元進，奉以為主。

translations.literal: Zhu Xie of Wu Commandery and Guan Chong of Jinling also raised troops with seventy thousand men; together they welcomed Yuanjin and installed him as leader.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xie of Wu Commandery and Guan Chong of Jinling also raised troops with seventy thousand men. Together they welcomed Yuanjin and installed him as leader.

sentences.zh: 據吳郡，稱為天子，以燮、崇俱為僕射，署百官。

translations.literal: They held Wu Commandery, styled themselves Son of Heaven, and made Xie and Chong both Vice Ministers, appointing the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: They held Wu Commandery, — style name themselves Son of Heaven, and made Xie and Chong both Vice Ministers, appointing the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 帝令將軍吐萬緒、光祿大夫魚俱羅討焉。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered General Tuwann Xu and Grand Master of Splendor Yu Juruo to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: In time, the emperor ordered General Tuwann Xu and Grand Master of Splendor Yu Juruo to attack them.

sentences.zh: 為緒所敗，硃燮戰死。

translations.literal: They were defeated by Xu; Zhu Xie died in battle.
translations.idiomatic: In time, they were defeated by Xu; Zhu Xie died in battle.

sentences.zh: 俄而緒、俱羅並得罪。

translations.literal: Before long both Xu and Juruo were punished.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, both Xu and Juruo were punished.

sentences.zh: 江都郡丞王世充發兵擊之。

translations.literal: Assistant Administrator of Jiangdu Commandery Wang Shichong sent troops to attack them.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Shichong, assistant administrator of Jiangdu commandery, sent troops against them.

sentences.zh: 有大流星墜于江都，未及地而南逝，磨拂竹木皆有聲，至吳郡而落於地。

translations.literal: A great meteor fell at Jiangdu; before reaching the ground it sped south, rubbing bamboo and trees so all made sound, and fell to earth at Wu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: A great meteor fell at Jiangdu. Before reaching the ground it sped south, rubbing bamboo and trees so all made sound, and fell to earth at Wu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 元進惡之，令掘地入二丈得一石，徑丈餘。

translations.literal: Yuanjin hated this and ordered the ground dug two zhang deep, where a stone was found more than a zhang in diameter.
translations.idiomatic: Where a stone was found more than a zhang in diameter, and yuanjin hated this and ordered the ground dug two zhang deep.

sentences.zh: 數日，失石所在。

translations.literal: After several days the stone's location could not be found.
translations.idiomatic: Later, after several days the stone's location could not be found.

sentences.zh: 世充度江，元進遣兵人各持茅，因風縱火。

translations.literal: Shichong crossed the Yangtze; Yuanjin sent troops each holding straw and set fires with the wind.
translations.idiomatic: Shichong crossed the Yangtze. Yuanjin sent troops each holding straw and set fires with the wind.

sentences.zh: 世充大懼，將棄營。

translations.literal: Shichong was greatly afraid and was about to abandon camp.
translations.idiomatic: In time, shichong was greatly afraid and was about to abandon camp.

sentences.zh: 遇反風火轉，元進眾懼燒而退，世充大破之。

translations.literal: A contrary wind turned the fire; Yuanjin's masses feared being burned and retreated, and Shichong broke them utterly.
translations.idiomatic: A contrary wind turned the fire. Yuanjin's masses feared being burned and retreated, and Shichong broke them utterly.

sentences.zh: 元進及崇俱為世充所殺。

translations.literal: Yuanjin and Chong were both killed by Shichong.
translations.idiomatic: In time, yuanjin and Chong were both killed by Shichong.

sentences.zh: 世充坑其眾于黃亭澗，死者三萬人。

translations.literal: Shichong buried their masses alive at Huangting Stream; the dead numbered thirty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In time, shichong buried their masses alive at Huangting Stream; the dead numbered thirty thousand.

sentences.zh: 其後董道沖、沈法興、李子通等並乘此而起。

translations.literal: After this Dong Daochong, Shen Faxing, Li Zitong, and others all rose taking advantage of this.
translations.idiomatic: Shen Faxing, Li Zitong, and others all rose taking advantage of this, and after this Dong Daochong.

sentences.zh: 素母弟約。

translations.literal: Su's younger brother by the same mother, Yue.
translations.idiomatic: Su's younger brother by the same mother was Yue.

sentences.zh: 約字惠伯。

translations.literal: Yue, styled Huibo.
translations.idiomatic: Yue, — style name Huibo.

sentences.zh: 童兒時嘗登樹，墜地為查傷，由是竟為宦者。

translations.literal: As a child he once climbed a tree, fell, and was injured by a branch; for this reason he ended up a eunuch.
translations.idiomatic: As a child he once climbed a tree, fell, and was injured by a branch. For this reason he ended up a eunuch.

sentences.zh: 性如沈靜，內多譎詐，好學強記。

translations.literal: His nature was deep and quiet, inwardly full of deceit; he loved learning and had a strong memory.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was deep and quiet, inwardly full of deceit. He loved learning and had a strong memory.

sentences.zh: 素友愛之，凡有所為，先籌於約而行。

translations.literal: Su loved and trusted him; whatever Su undertook he first planned with Yue before acting.
translations.idiomatic: Su loved and trusted him. Whatever Su undertook he first planned with Yue before acting.

sentences.zh: 在周末，以素軍功賜爵安成縣公，拜上儀同三司。

translations.literal: Under the Zhou end, through Su's military merit he was granted the title Baron of Ancheng County and appointed Honorary Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Through Su's military merit he was granted the title Baron of Ancheng County and appointed Honorary Three Dukes, and under the Zhou end.

sentences.zh: 文帝受禪，歷位長秋卿、鄜州刺史、宗正、大理三少卿。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen received the Mandate he served as Director of the Autumn Office, Regional Inspector of Fuzhou, Director of the Imperial Clan, and Vice Director of the Court of Justice.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Wen received the Mandate he served as Director of the Autumn Office, Regional Inspector of Fuzhou, Director of the Imperial Clan, and Vice Director of the Court of Justice.

sentences.zh: 時皇太子無寵，晉王廣規奪宗，以素幸於上而雅信約，乃用張衡計，遣宇文述大以金寶賂約，因通王意，說之曰：「夫守正履道，固人臣之常致；

translations.literal: At that time the Crown Prince had no favor; the Prince of Jin, Guang, plotted to seize the succession. Because Su was favored by the emperor and deeply trusted Yue, he used Zhang Heng's plan and sent Yuwen Shu with great gold and jewels to bribe Yue, thereby conveying the prince's intent and persuading him, saying: "To keep upright and tread the Way is indeed the constant conduct of a minister;
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Crown Prince had no favor. The Prince of Jin, Guang, plotted to seize the succession. Because Su was favored by the emperor and deeply trusted Yue, he used Zhang Heng's plan and sent Yuwen Shu with great gold and jewels to bribe Yue, thereby conveying the prince's intent and persuading him, saying, "To keep upright and tread the Way is indeed the constant conduct of a minister;

sentences.zh: 反經合義，亦達者之令圖。

translations.literal: To go against the norm yet accord with righteousness is also the excellent design of the far-sighted.
translations.idiomatic: To go against the norm yet accord with righteousness is likewise the excellent design of the far-sighted.

sentences.zh: 自古賢人君子，莫不與時消息，以避禍患。

translations.literal: Since ancient times worthy men and gentlemen have all moved with the times to avoid disaster and harm.
translations.idiomatic: In time, since ancient times worthy men and gentlemen have all moved with the times to avoid disaster and harm.

sentences.zh: 公兄弟功名蓋世，用事有年，朝臣為足下家所屈辱者，可勝數哉？

translations.literal: Your lordship's brothers' fame and achievement cover the age and you have held power for years — how many court ministers have been humiliated by your household?
translations.idiomatic: In time, your lordship's brothers' fame and achievement cover the age and you have held power for years — how many court ministers have been humiliated by your household?

sentences.zh: 又儲宮以所欲不行，每切齒於執政。

translations.literal: Moreover the Heir Apparent, because his wishes are not fulfilled, constantly gnashes his teeth at those in power.
translations.idiomatic: Because his wishes are not fulfilled, constantly gnashes his teeth at those in power, and moreover the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 公雖自結於人主，而欲危公者亦多矣。

translations.literal: Though you attach yourselves to the ruler, those who wish you harm are also many.
translations.idiomatic: Those who wish you harm are also many, and though you attach yourselves to the ruler.

sentences.zh: 主上一旦棄群臣，公亦何以取庇？

translations.literal: If the ruler one day abandons his ministers, how will you find protection?
translations.idiomatic: In time, if the ruler one day abandons his ministers, how will you find protection?

sentences.zh: 今皇太子失愛于皇后，主上素有廢黜之心，此公所知也。

translations.literal: Now the Crown Prince has lost the empress's love and the ruler has long had intent to depose him — this your lordship knows.
translations.idiomatic: In time, now the Crown Prince has lost the empress's love and the ruler has long had intent to depose him — this your lordship knows.

sentences.zh: 今若請立晉王，在賢兄之口耳。

translations.literal: If you now request installing the Prince of Jin, it rests on your worthy elder brother's lips alone.
translations.idiomatic: It rests on your worthy elder brother's lips alone, and if you now request installing the Prince of Jin.

sentences.zh: 誠能因此時建大功，王必鎮銘於骨髓，斯則去累卵之危，成太山之安也。

translations.literal: If you can thereby at this time establish great merit, the prince will surely inscribe it in his marrow — then you escape the peril of an egg piled up and achieve the security of Mount Tai.
translations.idiomatic: The prince will surely inscribe it in his marrow — then you escape the peril of an egg piled up and achieve the security of Mount Tai, and if you can thereby at this time establish great merit.

sentences.zh: 」約然之，又白素。

translations.literal: " Yue agreed and reported to Su.
translations.idiomatic: In time, " Yue agreed and reported to Su.

sentences.zh: 素本凶險，聞之大喜，乃撫掌曰：「吾智慧殊不及此，賴汝起餘。

translations.literal: Su's nature was originally fierce and dangerous; hearing this he was greatly pleased and clapped his hands, saying: "My wisdom is far inferior to this — I rely on you to rouse what remains in me.
translations.idiomatic: Su's nature was originally fierce and dangerous. Hearing this he was greatly pleased and clapped his hands, saying, "My wisdom is far inferior to this — I rely on you to rouse what remains in me.

sentences.zh: 」約知其計行，復謂素曰：「今皇后之言，上無不用，宜因機會，早自結托，則匪惟長保榮祿，傳祚子孫。

translations.literal: " Yue knew the plan would succeed and again said to Su: "Now the empress's words — none go unused by the emperor; you should seize the opportunity and early attach yourselves to him, then not only will you long preserve rank and emolument but succession will pass to sons and grandsons.
translations.idiomatic: " Yue knew the plan would succeed and again said to Su, "Now the empress's words — none go unused by the emperor. You should seize the opportunity and early attach yourselves to him, then not only will you long preserve rank and emolument but succession will pass to sons and grandsons.

sentences.zh: 又晉王傾身禮士，聲名日盛；

translations.literal: Moreover the Prince of Jin bows his body to honor scholars and his reputation grows daily;
translations.idiomatic: In time, moreover the Prince of Jin bows his body to honor scholars and his reputation grows daily;

sentences.zh: 躬履節儉，有主上之風。

translations.literal: he personally practices thrift and has the bearing of the ruler.
translations.idiomatic: In time, he personally practices thrift and has the bearing of the ruler.

sentences.zh: 以約料之，必能安天下。

translations.literal: By Yue's estimate he will surely be able to settle the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In Yue's judgment he will surely be able to settle the realm.

sentences.zh: 兄若遲疑，一旦有變，令太子用事，恐禍至無日。

translations.literal: If elder brother hesitates, once there is sudden change and the Crown Prince holds power, I fear disaster will come within days.
translations.idiomatic: Once there is sudden change and the Crown Prince holds power, I fear disaster will come within days, and if elder brother hesitates.

sentences.zh: 」素遂行其策，太子果廢。

translations.literal: " Su thereupon carried out the plan and the Crown Prince was indeed deposed.
translations.idiomatic: " Su at that point carried out the plan and the Crown Prince was indeed deposed.

sentences.zh: 及帝在東都，令約詣京師享廟，行至華陰，見其先墓。

translations.literal: When the emperor was at the eastern capital he ordered Yue to go to the capital to offer at the ancestral temple; traveling to Huayin he saw his ancestors' tombs.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor was at the eastern capital he ordered Yue to go to the capital to offer at the ancestral temple. Traveling to Huayin he saw his ancestors' tombs.

sentences.zh: 遂枉道拜哭，為憲司所劾，坐免官。

translations.literal: He thereupon left the route to bow and weep and was impeached by the censorate; he was dismissed from office.
translations.idiomatic: He thereupon left the route to bow and weep and was impeached by the censorate. He was dismissed from office.

sentences.zh: 尋拜浙陽太守。

translations.literal: Before long he was appointed Grand Administrator of Zheyang.
translations.idiomatic: It was not long before he was named Grand Administrator of Zheyang.

sentences.zh: 其兄子玄感時為禮部尚書，與約恩義甚篤，既愴分離，形於顏色。

translations.literal: His elder brother's son Xuangan was then Minister of Rites and was very close in friendship with Yue; grieved at parting, his distress showed on his face.
translations.idiomatic: His elder brother's son Xuangan was then Minister of Rites and was very close in friendship with Yue. Grieved at parting, his distress showed on his face.

sentences.zh: 帝謂曰：「公比憂瘁，得非為叔也？

translations.literal: The emperor said to him: "You seem more sorrowful than usual — is it not for your uncle?
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said to him, "You seem more sorrowful than usual — is it not for your uncle?

sentences.zh: 」玄感再拜流涕曰：「誠如聖旨。

translations.literal: " Xuangan bowed again with streaming tears and said: "It is indeed as Your Majesty says.
translations.idiomatic: " Xuangan bowed again with streaming tears and said, "It is indeed as Your Majesty says.

sentences.zh: 」帝亦思約廢立功，由是征入朝。

translations.literal: " The emperor also remembered Yue's merit in deposing the former heir and therefore summoned him to court.
translations.idiomatic: In time, " The emperor also remembered Yue's merit in deposing the former heir and therefore summoned him to court.

sentences.zh: 未幾卒，以素子玄挺後之。

translations.literal: Before long he died; Su's son Xuanting was made his heir.
translations.idiomatic: He died not long after; Su's son Xuanting was made his heir.

sentences.zh: 穆字紹叔，暄弟也。

translations.literal: Mu, styled Shaoshu, was Xuan's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Mu, — style name Shaoshu, was Xuan's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 仕魏，華州別駕。

translations.literal: He served Wei as Vice Administrator of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: They served Wei as Vice Administrator of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 孝武末，弟寬請以澄城縣伯讓穆，詔許之。

translations.literal: At the end of Emperor Xiaowu's reign his younger brother Kuan requested to yield the Baron of Chengcheng County to Mu; an edict approved this.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Emperor Xiaowu's reign his younger brother Kuan requested to yield the Baron of Chengcheng County to Mu. An edict approved this.

sentences.zh: 終於并州刺史，贈開府儀同三司、華州刺史。

translations.literal: He ended as Regional Inspector of Bingzhou; posthumously granted Grand Master of the Palace with Honorary Three Dukes and Regional Inspector of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: He ended as Regional Inspector of Bingzhou. Posthumously granted Grand Master of the Palace with Honorary Three Dukes and Regional Inspector of Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 穆弟儉，字景則。

translations.literal: Mu's younger brother Jian, styled Jingze.
translations.idiomatic: Mu's younger brother Jian, — style name Jingze.

sentences.zh: 偉容儀，有才行。

translations.literal: He had a imposing appearance and both ability and conduct.
translations.idiomatic: He had an imposing appearance and both ability and conduct.

sentences.zh: 位北雍州刺史，政尚寬惠，夷夏安之。

translations.literal: He held the post of Regional Inspector of Northern Yongzhou; his governance valued generosity and the barbarians and Chinese were at peace.
translations.idiomatic: He held the post of Regional Inspector of Northern Yongzhou. His governance valued generosity and the barbarians and Chinese were at peace.

sentences.zh: 後從破齊神武于沙苑，封夏陽縣侯，位開府儀同三司、華州刺史。

translations.literal: Later he followed in breaking Qi Shenwu at Shayuan and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xiayang County, holding the posts of Grand Master of the Palace with Honorary Three Dukes and Regional Inspector of Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: Holding the posts of Grand Master of the Palace with Honorary Three Dukes and Regional Inspector of Huazhou, and later he followed in breaking Qi Shenwu at Shayuan and was enfeoffed as Marquis of Xiayang County.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡靜。

translations.literal: When he died his posthumous title was Jing.
translations.idiomatic: When he died his posthumous title was Jing.

sentences.zh: 子異，字文殊。

translations.literal: His son Yi, styled Wenshu.
translations.idiomatic: His son Yi, — style name Wenshu.

sentences.zh: 美風儀，有器局。

translations.literal: He had fine bearing and capacity.
translations.idiomatic: In time, he had fine bearing and capacity.

sentences.zh: 髫齔就學，日誦千言，見者奇之。

translations.literal: While still in infancy he began study and daily recited a thousand words; those who saw him marveled.
translations.idiomatic: Once while still in infancy he began study and daily recited a thousand words; those who saw him marveled.

sentences.zh: 九歲丁父憂，哀毀過禮，殆將滅性。

translations.literal: At nine he entered mourning for his father; his grief exceeded the rites and he nearly destroyed his life.
translations.idiomatic: At nine he entered mourning for his father. His grief exceeded the rites and he nearly destroyed his life.

sentences.zh: 及免喪之後，絕慶吊，閉戶讀書。

translations.literal: When mourning ended he ceased congratulations and condolences and closed his door to read books.
translations.idiomatic: Once mourning ended he ceased congratulations and condolences and closed his door to read books.

sentences.zh: 數年之間，博涉書記。

translations.literal: Within several years he broadly mastered records and writings.
translations.idiomatic: In time, within several years he broadly mastered records and writings.

sentences.zh: 周閔帝時，為甯都郡太守，甚有能名，賜爵樂昌縣子，後數以軍功進爵為侯。

translations.literal: During Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou's reign he was Grand Administrator of Ningdu Commandery with a very able reputation; he was granted the title Baron of Lechang County and later through repeated military merit his title was advanced to marquis.
translations.idiomatic: During Emperor Xiaomin of Zhou's reign he was Grand Administrator of Ningdu Commandery with a very able reputation. He was granted the title Baron of Lechang County and later through repeated military merit his title was advanced to marquis.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝作相，行濟州事。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui was chief minister he handled affairs of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Wen of Sui was chief minister he handled affairs of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 及踐阼，拜宗正少卿，加上開府。

translations.literal: When he ascended the throne Yi was appointed Vice Director of the Imperial Clan with the added title Senior Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Once he ascended the throne Yi was appointed Vice Director of the Imperial Clan with the added title Senior Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 蜀王秀之鎮益州也，朝廷盛選綱紀，以異方直，拜益州總管長史，尋遷西南道行台兵部尚書。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Shu, Xiu, governed Yizhou the court carefully selected administrators; because Yi was upright he was made Chief Administrator of the Yizhou headquarters, and soon transferred to Minister of the Seven Arms of the Southwest Circuit Grand Commission.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Shu, Xiu, governed Yizhou the court carefully selected administrators. Because Yi was upright he was made Chief Administrator of the Yizhou headquarters, and soon transferred to Minister of the Seven Arms of the Southwest Circuit Grand Commission.

sentences.zh: 後曆宗正卿、刑部尚書，出為吳州總管，甚有能名。

translations.literal: Later he served as Director of the Imperial Clan and Minister of Punishments, then went out as Commander of Wuzhou with a very able reputation.
translations.idiomatic: Then went out as Commander of Wuzhou with a very able reputation, and later he served as Director of the Imperial Clan and Minister of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 時晉王廣鎮揚州，詔令異每歲一與王相見，評論得失，規諫疑闕。

translations.literal: At that time the Prince of Jin, Guang, governed Yangzhou; an edict ordered Yi to meet with the prince once each year to discuss gains and losses and remonstrate regarding doubts and omissions.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the Prince of Jin, Guang, governed Yangzhou. An edict ordered Yi to meet with the prince once each year to discuss gains and losses and remonstrate regarding doubts and omissions.

sentences.zh: 卒於官。

translations.literal: He died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office.

sentences.zh: 子虔遜。

translations.literal: His son Qianxun.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Qianxun.

sentences.zh: 寬子蒙仁，儉弟也。

translations.literal: Kuan, styled Mengren, was Jian's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan, — style name Mengren, was Jian's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 少有大志，每與諸兒童遊處，必擇高大之物坐之，見者咸異焉。

translations.literal: From youth he had great ambition; whenever he played with other children he always chose the highest and largest thing to sit on — all who saw marveled.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he had great ambition. Whenever he played with other children he always chose the highest and largest thing to sit on — all who saw marveled.

sentences.zh: 及長，頗解屬文，尤尚武藝。

translations.literal: When he grew up he was quite skilled at literary composition and especially valued martial arts.
translations.idiomatic: As an adult he was quite skilled at literary composition and especially valued martial arts.

sentences.zh: 弱冠，除奉朝請。

translations.literal: At his capping he was appointed Attendant at Court.
translations.idiomatic: At his capping ceremony he was appointed Attendant at Court.

sentences.zh: 父鈞出鎮恆州，請隨從展效，乃授高闕戍主。

translations.literal: When his father Jun went out to govern Hengzhou he requested to follow and show merit and was therefore made commander of Gaolue garrison.
translations.idiomatic: In time, when his father Jun went out to govern Hengzhou he requested to follow and show merit and was therefore made commander of Gaolue garrison.

sentences.zh: 既而蠕蠕亂，共主阿那瑰奔魏，魏帝詔鈞衛送，寬亦從行。

translations.literal: Before long the Ruru were in turmoil; their chief Anagui fled to Wei; the Wei emperor ordered Jun to escort and guard him, and Kuan also followed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the Ruru were in turmoil. Their chief Anagui fled to Wei; the Wei emperor ordered Jun to escort and guard him, and Kuan also followed.

sentences.zh: 時北邊賊起，攻圍鎮城。

translations.literal: At that time bandits rose on the northern frontier and attacked and besieged the garrison town.
translations.idiomatic: In time, at that time bandits rose on the northern frontier and attacked and besieged the garrison town.

sentences.zh: 鈞卒，城人等推寬守禦。

translations.literal: Jun died and the people of the town pushed Kuan to defend.
translations.idiomatic: In time, jun died and the people of the town pushed Kuan to defend.

sentences.zh: 尋而城陷，寬乃北走蠕蠕，後討六鎮賊破，寬始得還朝。

translations.literal: Before long the town fell; Kuan fled north to the Ruru, and later when the Six Garrisons rebels were defeated Kuan was able to return to court.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the town fell. Kuan fled north to the Ruru, and later when the Six Garrisons rebels were defeated Kuan was able to return to court.

sentences.zh: 廣陽王深與寬素相昵，深犯法得罪，寬被逮捕。

translations.literal: The Prince of Guangyang, Shen, was intimate with Kuan by nature; Shen violated the law and was punished, and Kuan was arrested.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Guangyang, Shen, was intimate with Kuan by nature. Shen violated the law and was punished, and Kuan was arrested.

sentences.zh: 孝莊為侍中，與寬有舊，藏之於宅，遇赦得免。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaozhuang as Palace Attendant had old ties with Kuan and hid him in his residence; he met with an amnesty and escaped punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaozhuang as Palace Attendant had old ties with Kuan and hid him in his residence. He met with an amnesty and escaped punishment.

sentences.zh: 除宗正丞。

translations.literal: He was appointed Assistant Director of the Imperial Clan.
translations.idiomatic: They appointed him as Assistant Director of the Imperial Clan.

sentences.zh: 北海王顥少相器重，時為大行臺北征葛榮，欲啟寬為左丞。

translations.literal: The Prince of Beihai, Hao, valued him highly from youth; he was then Grand Commissioner campaigning north against Ge Rong and wished to appoint Kuan Left Director.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Beihai, Hao, valued him highly from youth. He was then Grand Commissioner campaigning north against Ge Rong and wished to appoint Kuan Left Director.

sentences.zh: 寬辭以孝莊厚恩未報，義不見利而動。

translations.literal: Kuan declined, saying Xiaozhuang's deep grace had not been repaid and it was not righteous to move for profit.
translations.idiomatic: In time, kuan declined, saying Xiaozhuang's deep grace had not been repaid and it was not righteous to move for profit.

sentences.zh: 顥未之許，顥妹婿李神軌謂顥曰：「匹夫猶不可奪志，況義士乎。

translations.literal: Hao did not agree; Hao's sister's husband Li Shengui said to Hao: "Even a common man cannot have his resolve taken from him — how much more a man of righteousness!
translations.idiomatic: Hao did not agree. Hao's sister's husband Li Shengui said to Hao, "Even a common man cannot have his resolve taken from him — how much more a man of righteousness!

sentences.zh: 」乃止。

translations.literal: " Thereupon he desisted.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereupon he desisted.

sentences.zh: 孝莊踐阼，累遷洛陽令，以都督從太宰、上党王元穆討平邢杲。

translations.literal: When Xiaozhuang ascended the throne Kuan was repeatedly promoted to Magistrate of Luoyang and as area commander followed the Grand Preceptor, the Prince of Shangdang, Yuan Mu, in pacifying Xing Gao.
translations.idiomatic: After Xiaozhuang took the throne the throne Kuan was repeatedly promoted to Magistrate of Luoyang and as area commander followed the Grand Preceptor, the Prince of Shangdang, Yuan Mu, in pacifying Xing Gao.

sentences.zh: 師未還。

translations.literal: The army had not yet returned.
translations.idiomatic: The army had not yet returned.

sentences.zh: 屬元顥入洛，莊帝出居河內。

translations.literal: Just then Yuan Hao entered Luoyang and Emperor Zhuang went out to reside at Henei.
translations.idiomatic: In time, just then Yuan Hao entered Luoyang and Emperor Zhuang went out to reside at Henei.

sentences.zh: 天穆懼，集諸將謀之。

translations.literal: Tian Mu was afraid and gathered the generals to discuss.
translations.idiomatic: In time, tian Mu was afraid and gathered the generals to discuss.

sentences.zh: 寬勸天穆徑取成皋，會兵伊、洛。

translations.literal: Kuan urged Tian Mu to take Chenggao directly and assemble troops at the Yi and Luo rivers.
translations.idiomatic: In time, kuan urged Tian Mu to take Chenggao directly and assemble troops at the Yi and Luo rivers.

sentences.zh: 天穆然之，乃趣成皋，令寬與爾硃兆為後拒。

translations.literal: Tian Mu agreed and hurried to Chenggao, ordering Kuan and Erzhu Zhao to serve as rear guard.
translations.idiomatic: Ordering Kuan and Erzhu Zhao to serve as rear guard, and tian Mu agreed and hurried to Chenggao.

sentences.zh: 尋以眾議不同，乃回赴石濟。

translations.literal: Before long because opinions differed they turned back toward Shiji.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, because opinions differed they turned back toward Shiji.

sentences.zh: 寬夜行失道，遂後期，諸將咸言寬少與北海周旋，今不來矣。

translations.literal: Kuan traveled by night and lost the way, thus arriving late; the generals all said Kuan had long associated with Beihai and would not come.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan traveled by night and lost the way, thus arriving late. The generals all said Kuan had long associated with Beihai and would not come.

sentences.zh: 天穆答曰：「楊寬非輕去就者也，吾當為諸君明之。

translations.literal: Tian Mu replied: "Yang Kuan is not one to leave lightly — I will make this clear to you all.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Mu replied, "Yang Kuan is not one to leave lightly — I will make this clear to you all.

sentences.zh: 」言訖，候騎白寬至。

translations.literal: " When he finished speaking scouts reported Kuan had arrived.
translations.idiomatic: " As he finished speaking scouts reported Kuan had arrived.

sentences.zh: 天穆撫髀而笑曰：「吾固知其必來。

translations.literal: Tian Mu slapped his thigh and laughed: "I knew fixedly he would come.
translations.idiomatic: Tian Mu slapped his thigh and laughed, "I knew fixedly he would come.

sentences.zh: 」遽出帳迎，握其手曰：「是所望也」與天穆俱謁孝莊於太行。

translations.literal: " He at once went out of the tent to welcome him, grasped his hand and said: "This is what I hoped for," and together with Tian Mu paid respects to Xiaozhuang at Mount Taihang.
translations.idiomatic: " He at once went out of the tent to welcome him, grasped his hand and said, "This is what I hoped for," and together with Tian Mu paid respects to Xiaozhuang at Mount Taihang.

sentences.zh: 仍為都督，從平河內，進圍北中。

translations.literal: He again served as area commander, followed in pacifying Henei, and advanced to besiege the Northern Center.
translations.idiomatic: Followed in pacifying Henei, and advanced to besiege the Northern Center, and he again served as area commander.

sentences.zh: 時梁陳慶之為顥勒兵守北門，天穆駐馬圍外，遣寬至城下說慶之，不答，久之乃曰：「賢兄撫軍在，頗欲相見不？

translations.literal: At that time Liang's Chen Qingzhi for Hao led troops guarding the North Gate; Tian Mu halted his horse outside the encirclement and sent Kuan to the foot of the wall to persuade Qingzhi; there was no answer; after a long time he finally said: "Your worthy elder brother the Pacification General is here — do you not wish to see him?
translations.idiomatic: At that time Liang's Chen Qingzhi for Hao led troops guarding the North Gate. Tian Mu halted his horse outside the encirclement and sent Kuan to the foot of the wall to persuade Qingzhi; there was no answer. After a long time he finally said, "Your worthy elder brother the Pacification General is here — do you not wish to see him?

sentences.zh: 」寬答：「僕兄既力屈凶威，跡淪逆黨，人臣之理，何煩相見。

translations.literal: " Kuan replied: "My elder brother has exhausted his strength against villainous might and his traces belong to the rebel party — the principle of a minister; why trouble about meeting?
translations.idiomatic: " Kuan replied, "My elder brother has exhausted his strength against villainous might and his traces belong to the rebel party — the principle of a minister. Why trouble about meeting?

sentences.zh: 」天穆聞之，自此彌敬。

translations.literal: " Tian Mu heard this and from then on respected him ever more.
translations.idiomatic: In time, " Tian Mu heard this and from then on respected him ever more.

sentences.zh: 孝莊反正，除太府卿、華州大中正，封澄城縣伯。

translations.literal: When Xiaozhuang restored the correct order Kuan was appointed Director of the Treasury and Senior Arbiter of Huazhou, enfeoffed as Baron of Chengcheng County.
translations.idiomatic: Once Xiaozhuang restored the correct order Kuan was appointed Director of the Treasury and Senior Arbiter of Huazhou, enfeoffed as Baron of Chengcheng County.

sentences.zh: 爾硃榮被誅，其從弟世澄等出據河橋，還逼京師，進寬使持節、大都督，隨機捍禦。

translations.literal: When Erzhu Rong was executed his younger cousin Shicheng and others seized the River Bridge and turned back to press the capital; Kuan was advanced as bearer of the staff of authority and Grand Area Commander to resist as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: When Erzhu Rong was executed his younger cousin Shicheng and others seized the River Bridge and turned back to press the capital. Kuan was advanced as bearer of the staff of authority and Grand Area Commander to resist as circumstances required.

sentences.zh: 世隆謂寬曰：「豈忘大宰相知之深也？

translations.literal: Shilong said to Kuan: "Have you forgotten how deeply the Grand Chancellor knew you?
translations.idiomatic: Shilong said to Kuan, "Have you forgotten how deeply the Grand Chancellor knew you?

sentences.zh: 」寬答曰：「太宰見愛以禮，人臣之交耳，今日之事，事君之節。

translations.literal: " Kuan replied: "The Grand Preceptor treated me with courtesy in friendship — that is the exchange of ministers. Today's affair is the integrity of serving one's ruler.
translations.idiomatic: " Kuan replied, "The Grand Preceptor treated me with courtesy in friendship — that is the exchange of ministers. Today's affair is the integrity of serving one's ruler.

sentences.zh: 」及爾硃兆陷洛陽，囚執孝莊帝，寬還洛不可，遂自成皋奔梁。

translations.literal: " When Erzhu Zhao took Luoyang and imprisoned Emperor Zhuang, Kuan could not return to Luoyang and therefore from Chenggao fled to Liang.
translations.idiomatic: Kuan could not return to Luoyang and therefore from Chenggao fled to Liang, and " When Erzhu Zhao took Luoyang and imprisoned Emperor Zhuang.

sentences.zh: 至建鄴，聞莊帝弑崩，寬發喪盡禮，梁武義之。

translations.literal: Reaching Jiankang he heard Emperor Zhuang had been murdered; Kuan observed mourning with full rites and Emperor Wu of Liang honored his righteousness.
translations.idiomatic: Reaching Jiankang he heard Emperor Zhuang had been murdered. Kuan observed mourning with full rites and Emperor Wu of Liang honored his righteousness.

sentences.zh: 尋而禮送還。

translations.literal: Before long he was sent back with ceremony.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after he was sent back with ceremony.

sentences.zh: 孝武初，除給事黃門侍郎。

translations.literal: Early in Emperor Xiaowu's reign he was appointed Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Emperor Xiaowu's reign he was named Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate.

sentences.zh: 孝武與齊神武有隙，遂召募驍勇，廣增宿衛，以寬為閣內大都督，專總禁旅。

translations.literal: Emperor Xiaowu had a rift with Qi Shenwu and therefore recruited the brave and bold, broadly increasing palace guard; Kuan was made Grand Area Commander within the palace gates, exclusively commanding the forbidden troops.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiaowu had a rift with Qi Shenwu and therefore recruited the brave and bold, broadly increasing palace guard. Kuan was made Grand Area Commander within the palace gates, exclusively commanding the forbidden troops.

sentences.zh: 從孝武入關，兼吏部尚書，錄從駕勳，進爵華山郡公。

translations.literal: Following Xiaowu into Guanzhong he was additionally Minister of Personnel, recording merit of those who followed the imperial carriage, and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Huashan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Recording merit of those who followed the imperial carriage, and advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Huashan Commandery, and following Xiaowu into Guanzhong he was additionally Minister of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 大統初，遷太子太傅。

translations.literal: Early in Datong he was transferred to Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Datong he was moved to Junior Tutor to the Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 五年，除驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司、都督、東雍州刺史，即本州也。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry, Grand Master of the Palace with Honorary Three Dukes, area commander, and Regional Inspector of Eastern Yongzhou — his native province.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Master of the Palace with Honorary Three Dukes, area commander, and Regional Inspector of Eastern Yongzhou — his native province, and in the fifth year he was appointed General of Agile Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 廢帝初，為尚書左僕射、將作大監，坐事免。

translations.literal: Early in the Deposed Emperor's reign he was Left Vice Minister of the Imperial Secretariat and Grand Supervisor of Construction but was dismissed for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: In time, early in the Deposed Emperor's reign he was Left Vice Minister of the Imperial Secretariat and Grand Supervisor of Construction but was dismissed for an offense.

sentences.zh: 周明帝初，拜大將軍，從駕蘭祥討吐谷渾，破之，別封宜陽縣公。

translations.literal: Early in Emperor Ming of Zhou's reign he was appointed Grand General and followed the imperial carriage with Lan Xiang in campaigning against Tuyuhun, breaking them; he was separately enfeoffed Duke of Yiyang County.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Emperor Ming of Zhou's reign he was appointed Grand General and followed the imperial carriage with Lan Xiang in campaigning against Tuyuhun, breaking them. He was separately enfeoffed Duke of Yiyang County.

sentences.zh: 除小塚宰，轉禦正中大夫。

translations.literal: He was appointed Junior Grand Minister and transferred to Director of the Imperial Wardrobe.
translations.idiomatic: They appointed him as Junior Grand Minister and transferred to Director of the Imperial Wardrobe.

sentences.zh: 武成二年，詔寬與麟趾殿學士參定經籍。

translations.literal: In the second year of Wucheng an edict ordered Kuan together with academicians of the Linqi Hall to collate the canonical texts.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the second year of Wucheng an edict ordered Kuan together with academicians of the Linqi Hall to collate the canonical texts.

sentences.zh: 寬性通敏，有器幹。

translations.literal: Kuan's nature was penetrating and keen with capacity and backbone.
translations.idiomatic: In time, kuan's nature was penetrating and keen with capacity and backbone.

sentences.zh: 頻牧數州，號稱清簡。

translations.literal: Repeatedly governing several provinces he was known for clarity and simplicity.
translations.idiomatic: In time, repeatedly governing several provinces he was known for clarity and simplicity.

sentences.zh: 曆居台閣，有當官之譽。

translations.literal: Serving long in the high offices he had a reputation for fulfilling his post.
translations.idiomatic: Serving long in the high offices, he earned a reputation for fulfilling his post.

sentences.zh: 然與柳機不協，案成其罪，時論頗以此譏之。

translations.literal: Yet he was not in harmony with Liu Ji and constructed a case to convict him; opinion at the time largely faulted him for this.
translations.idiomatic: Yet he was not in harmony with Liu Ji and constructed a case to convict him. Opinion at the time largely faulted him for this.

sentences.zh: 保定元年，除總管梁興等十九州諸軍事、梁州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoding he was appointed area commander of Liangxing and nineteen other provinces and Regional Inspector of Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In time, in the first year of Baoding he was appointed area commander of Liangxing and nineteen other provinces and Regional Inspector of Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 薨于州，贈華、陝、虞、上、潞五州刺史，諡曰元。

translations.literal: He died in the province; posthumously granted Regional Inspector of Hua, Shan, Yu, Shang, and Lu provinces; posthumous title Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the province. Posthumously granted Regional Inspector of Hua, Shan, Yu, Shang, and Lu provinces; posthumous title Yuan.

sentences.zh: 子文恩。

translations.literal: His son Wen'en.
translations.idiomatic: His son was Wen'en.

sentences.zh: 文恩字溫才。

translations.literal: Wen'en, styled Wencai.
translations.idiomatic: Wen'en, — style name Wencai.

sentences.zh: 在周，年十一，拜車騎大將軍、儀同三司、散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Under Zhou, at eleven he was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry, Honorary Three Dukes, and Regular Attendant Cavalier.
translations.idiomatic: In time, under Zhou, at eleven he was appointed General of Chariots and Cavalry, Honorary Three Dukes, and Regular Attendant Cavalier.

sentences.zh: 尋以父功，封新豐縣子。

translations.literal: Before long through his father's merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Xinfeng County.
translations.idiomatic: Not long after, through his father's merit he was enfeoffed Baron of Xinfeng County.

sentences.zh: 天和初，行武都太守。

translations.literal: Early in Tianhe he acted as Grand Administrator of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: In time, early in Tianhe he acted as Grand Administrator of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 十姓獠反，文恩討平之。

translations.literal: The ten-surname Liao rebelled; Wen'en attacked and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: The ten-surname Liao rebelled. Wen'en attacked and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 復行翼州事。

translations.literal: He again acted in affairs of Yizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He again handled affairs of Yizhou.

sentences.zh: 党項羌叛，文恩又討平之。

translations.literal: The Tangut Qiang rebelled; Wen'en again attacked and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: The Tangut Qiang rebelled. Wen'en again attacked and pacified them.

sentences.zh: 進擊資中、武康、隆山等生獠及東山獠，並破之。

translations.literal: He advanced to attack the raw Liao of Zizhong, Wukang, Longshan, and the eastern mountain Liao, and broke them all.
translations.idiomatic: He pushed forward and to attack the raw Liao of Zizhong, Wukang, Longshan, and the eastern mountain Liao, and broke them all.

sentences.zh: 從陳王攻齊河陰城，又從武帝攻拔晉州，授上儀同三司，改封承寧縣公。

translations.literal: He followed the Prince of Chen in attacking Heyin city of Qi and followed Emperor Wu in capturing Jinzhou; he was granted Honorary Three Dukes and his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Chengning County.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the Prince of Chen in attacking Heyin city of Qi and followed Emperor Wu in capturing Jinzhou. He was granted Honorary Three Dukes and his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Chengning County.

sentences.zh: 壽陽劉叔仁作亂，從清河公宇文神舉討之，戰于鹆專井，在陣禽叔仁。

translations.literal: Shouyang's Liu Shuren rebelled; following the Duke of Qinghe, Yuwen Shenju, he attacked them; fighting at Yuzhuan Well he captured Shuren in the battle line.
translations.idiomatic: Shouyang's Liu Shuren rebelled. Following the Duke of Qinghe, Yuwen Shenju, he attacked them. Fighting at Yuzhuan Well he captured Shuren in the battle line.

sentences.zh: 又別從王誼破賊於鯉魚柵。

translations.literal: He also separately followed Wang Yi in breaking bandits at Carp Palisade.
translations.idiomatic: He likewise separately followed Wang Yi in breaking bandits at Carp Palisade.

sentences.zh: 後累以軍功遷果毅左旅下大夫。

translations.literal: Later through repeated military merit he was promoted to Left Brigade Deputy Commander of Guoyi.
translations.idiomatic: In time, later through repeated military merit he was promoted to Left Brigade Deputy Commander of Guoyi.

sentences.zh: 隋文帝為丞相，從韋孝寬拒尉遲迥于武陟，與行軍總管宇文述擊走其將李俊，遂解懷州圍。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui was chief minister Wen'en followed Wei Xiaokuan in resisting Yuchi Jiong at Wuzhi and together with campaigning commander Yuwen Shu drove off his general Li Jun, thus relieving the siege of Huaizhou.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Wen of Sui was chief minister Wen'en followed Wei Xiaokuan in resisting Yuchi Jiong at Wuzhi and together with campaigning commander Yuwen Shu drove off his general Li Jun, thus relieving the siege of Huaizhou.

sentences.zh: 破尉遲惇，平鄴城，皆有功，進授上大將軍，改封洛川縣公，尋拜隆州刺史。

translations.literal: He broke Yuchi Dun and pacified Ye city — all with merit; he was advanced to Superior Grand General, his enfeoffment changed to Duke of Luochuan County, and soon appointed Regional Inspector of Longzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He broke Yuchi Dun and pacified Ye city — all with merit. He was advanced to Superior Grand General, his enfeoffment changed to Duke of Luochuan County, and soon appointed Regional Inspector of Longzhou.

sentences.zh: 開皇元年，進爵正平郡公。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kaihuang his title was advanced to Duke of Zhengping Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: That year, in the first year of Kaihuang his title was advanced to Duke of Zhengping Commandery.

sentences.zh: 後為魏州刺史，甚有惠政，及去職，吏人思之，為立碑頌德。

translations.literal: Later he was Regional Inspector of Weizhou with very benevolent governance; when he left office officials and people missed him and erected a stele praising his virtue.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was Regional Inspector of Weizhou with very benevolent governance. When he left office officials and people missed him and erected a stele praising his virtue.

sentences.zh: 轉冀州刺史。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Regional Inspector of Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to Regional Inspector of Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 煬帝嗣位，徵為戶部尚書，轉納言，改授右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: When Emperor Yang succeeded he was summoned as Minister of Revenue, transferred to Chief Censor, and reassigned Right Grand Master of Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Once Emperor Yang succeeded he was summoned as Minister of Revenue, transferred to Chief Censor, and reassigned Right Grand Master of Splendor.

sentences.zh: 從幸江都宮，以足疾，不堪趨奏，復授戶部尚書，位右光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Following the emperor to Jiangdu Palace, because of foot ailment he could not hurry to audience; he was again appointed Minister of Revenue, holding the rank of Right Grand Master of Splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Following the emperor to Jiangdu Palace, because of foot ailment he could not hurry to audience. He was again appointed Minister of Revenue, holding the rank of Right Grand Master of Splendor.

sentences.zh: 卒官，諡曰定。

translations.literal: He died in office; posthumous title Ding.
translations.idiomatic: They died in office; posthumous title Ding.

sentences.zh: 初文恩當襲父爵，自以非嫡，遂讓弟紀，當世多之。

translations.literal: Initially Wen'en was to inherit his father's title but, considering himself not the eldest son, yielded to his younger brother Ji — the age greatly praised this.
translations.idiomatic: Considering himself not the eldest son, yielded to his younger brother Ji — the age greatly praised this, and initially Wen'en was to inherit his father's title but.

sentences.zh: 紀字溫范，少剛正，有器局。

translations.literal: Ji, styled Wenfan, was from youth stern and upright with capacity and backbone.
translations.idiomatic: Ji, style name Wenfan, was from youth stern and upright with capacity and backbone.

sentences.zh: 在周，襲爵華山郡公。

translations.literal: Under Zhou he inherited the title Duke of Huashan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In time, under Zhou he inherited the title Duke of Huashan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 累遷安州總管長史，將兵迎陳降將王瑗于齊安，與陳將周法尚遇，擊走之，以功進開府。

translations.literal: Repeatedly promoted to Chief Administrator of Anzhou headquarters; he led troops to welcome Chen defector Wang Yuan at Qi'an, met Chen general Zhou Fashang, attacked and drove him off; for merit he was advanced to Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Repeatedly promoted to Chief Administrator of Anzhou headquarters. He led troops to welcome Chen defector Wang Yuan at Qi'an, met Chen general Zhou Fashang, attacked and drove him off; for merit he was advanced to Grand Master of the Palace.

sentences.zh: 入為虞部下大夫。

translations.literal: He entered court as Deputy Director of the Parks Office.
translations.idiomatic: He took office as Deputy Director of the Parks Office.

sentences.zh: 文帝為丞相，改封汾陰縣公。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen was chief minister his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Fenyin County.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Wen was chief minister his enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Fenyin County.

sentences.zh: 從梁睿討王謙，以功進授上大將軍。

translations.literal: Following Liang Rui in attacking Wang Qian he was advanced to Superior Grand General for merit.
translations.idiomatic: In time, following Liang Rui in attacking Wang Qian he was advanced to Superior Grand General for merit.

sentences.zh: 曆資州刺史、宗正少卿，坐事除名。

translations.literal: He served as Regional Inspector of Zizhou and Vice Director of the Imperial Clan but was stripped of name for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: In time, he served as Regional Inspector of Zizhou and Vice Director of the Imperial Clan but was stripped of name for an offense.

sentences.zh: 後尋復其爵位，拜熊州刺史，改封上明郡公。

translations.literal: Later his title and rank were soon restored; he was appointed Regional Inspector of Xiongzhou and his enfeoffment changed to Duke of Shangming Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Later his title and rank were soon restored. He was appointed Regional Inspector of Xiongzhou and his enfeoffment changed to Duke of Shangming Commandery.

sentences.zh: 除宗正卿，兼給事黃門侍郎，判禮部尚書事。

translations.literal: He was appointed Director of the Imperial Clan and Concurrent Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, acting as Minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: They appointed him as Director of the Imperial Clan and Concurrent Attendant Gentleman of the Yellow Gate, acting as Minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 遷荊州總管。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Commander of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He moved to Commander of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 卒，諡曰恭。

translations.literal: When he died his posthumous title was Gong.
translations.idiomatic: At his death his posthumous title was Gong.

sentences.zh: 論曰：楊播兄弟俱以忠毅謙謹，荷內外之任；

translations.literal: The commentator says: Yang Bo's brothers were all loyal, resolute, humble, and cautious, bearing inner and outer appointments;
translations.idiomatic: In time, the commentator says: Yang Bo's brothers were all loyal, resolute, humble, and cautious, bearing inner and outer appointments;

sentences.zh: 公卿牧守，榮赫累朝，所謂門生故吏遍於天下。

translations.literal: as dukes, ministers, and regional governors their glory lasted for generations — what is called having students and former subordinates throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In time, as dukes, ministers, and regional governors their glory lasted for generations — what is called having students and former subordinates throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 而言色恂恂，出於誠至；

translations.literal: Yet their words and bearing were respectful, springing from utmost sincerity;
translations.idiomatic: In time, yet their words and bearing were respectful, springing from utmost sincerity;

sentences.zh: 恭德慎行，為世師範，漢之陳紀，門法所不過焉。

translations.literal: their reverent virtue and careful conduct were models for the age — Han's Chen Ji is not surpassed by their family standards.
translations.idiomatic: In time, their reverent virtue and careful conduct were models for the age — Han's Chen Ji is not surpassed by their family standards.

sentences.zh: 後魏以來，一門而已。

translations.literal: Since Later Wei there has been only this one clan.
translations.idiomatic: Since Later Wei there has been only this one clan to compare.

sentences.zh: 諸子秀立，青紫盈庭，積善之慶，蓋有憑也。

translations.literal: Their sons stood out elegantly; blue and purple filled the court — the reward of accumulated good fortune surely had its basis.
translations.idiomatic: In time, their sons stood out elegantly; blue and purple filled the court — the reward of accumulated good fortune surely had its basis.

sentences.zh: 及逆胡擅朝，淫刑肆毒，以斯族而遇斯禍，何報施之反哉。

translations.literal: When the rebellious Hu monopolized the court and wanton punishments ran riot, that this clan should meet such disaster — how perverse the retribution!
translations.idiomatic: In time, when the rebellious Hu monopolized the court and wanton punishments ran riot, that this clan should meet such disaster — how perverse the retribution!

sentences.zh: 愔雅道風流，早同標緻，公望人物所推。

translations.literal: Yin, refined and upright in the Way, was accomplished and elegant; from early on they shared the same distinction — men of public esteem whom people admired.
translations.idiomatic: Yin, refined and upright in the Way, was accomplished and elegant. From early on they shared the same distinction — men of public esteem whom people admired.

sentences.zh: 夫處亂虐之世，當機衡之重，朝有善政，是也。

translations.literal: To stand in a violent, tyrannical age and hold the weight of the state balance — that the court had good government was due to this.
translations.idiomatic: Tyrannical age and hold the weight of the state balance — that the court had good government was due to this, and to stand in a violent.

sentences.zh: 及寄天下之命，托六尺之孤，旬朔未幾，身亡君辱。

translations.literal: Yet when the mandate of the realm was entrusted to them and the young orphan was placed in their care, within a few weeks the ruler died and the lord was shamed.
translations.idiomatic: Within a few weeks the ruler died and the lord was shamed, and yet when the mandate of the realm was entrusted to them and the young orphan was placed in their care.

sentences.zh: 進不能送往事居，觀幾衛主；

translations.literal: Advancing, they could not serve the departed and succor the living, watch for signs and guard the sovereign;
translations.idiomatic: In time, advancing, they could not serve the departed and succor the living, watch for signs and guard the sovereign;

sentences.zh: 退不能保身全名，辭寵招福。

translations.literal: retreating, they could not preserve their persons and keep their names intact, decline favor and summon blessing.
translations.idiomatic: In time, retreating, they could not preserve their persons and keep their names intact, decline favor and summon blessing.

sentences.zh: 朝廷之釁，既已仗義斷恩；

translations.literal: Once the court breach had already been cut by righteous severing of ties;
translations.idiomatic: In time, once the court breach had already been cut by righteous severing of ties;

sentences.zh: 猜忌之塗，無容推心受亂。

translations.literal: on the road of suspicion there was no room to open their hearts and accept turmoil.
translations.idiomatic: In time, on the road of suspicion there was no room to open their hearts and accept turmoil.

sentences.zh: 是知變通之術，非所長也。

translations.literal: From this one knows that the art of adaptation was not their strength.
translations.idiomatic: From this one knows that the art of adaptation was not their strong suit.

sentences.zh: 處道少而輕俠，俶儻不羈；

translations.literal: Chudao in youth was lightly chivalrous, bold and unrestrained;
translations.idiomatic: In time, chudao in youth was lightly chivalrous, bold and unrestrained;

sentences.zh: 兼文武之資，包英奇之略，志懷遠大，以功名自許。

translations.literal: combining civil and military talent and encompassing extraordinary strategy, his ambition was far-reaching and he pledged himself to merit and fame.
translations.idiomatic: His ambition was far-reaching and he pledged himself to merit and fame, and combining civil and military talent and encompassing extraordinary strategy.

sentences.zh: 屬隋文帝將清六合，委以腹心之寄。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui was about to pacify the realm, he entrusted him with the innermost confidence.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Wen of Sui was about to pacify the realm, he entrusted him with the innermost confidence.

sentences.zh: 掃妖氛于牛鬥，江海恬波；

translations.literal: He swept demonic vapors from the Bull and Dipper — rivers and seas lay calm;
translations.idiomatic: In time, he swept demonic vapors from the Bull and Dipper — rivers and seas lay calm;

sentences.zh: 摧驍猛于龍庭，匈奴遠遁。

translations.literal: he crushed fierce warriors at the Dragon Court — the Xiongnu fled far away.
translations.idiomatic: at the Dragon Court he crushed fierce warriors — the Xiongnu fled far away.

sentences.zh: 若其夷凶靜亂，功臣莫居其右；

translations.literal: In pacifying the wicked and quelling disorder, no meritorious minister stood above him;
translations.idiomatic: In time, in pacifying the wicked and quelling disorder, no meritorious minister stood above him;

sentences.zh: 覽其奇策高文，足為一時之傑。

translations.literal: reading his ingenious stratagems and lofty writings, he was fully the outstanding man of his age.
translations.idiomatic: He was fully the outstanding man of his age, and reading his ingenious stratagems and lofty writings.

sentences.zh: 然以智詐自立，不由仁義之道，阿諛時主，高下其心。

translations.literal: Yet relying on cunning and fraud to establish himself, not following the path of benevolence and righteousness, he flattered the ruler of the time and raised or lowered his heart according to convenience.
translations.idiomatic: Not following the path of benevolence and righteousness, he flattered the ruler of the time and raised or lowered his heart according to convenience, and yet relying on cunning and fraud to establish himself.

sentences.zh: 營構離宮，陷君於奢侈；

translations.literal: He built detached palaces and plunged the ruler into extravagance;
translations.idiomatic: In time, he built detached palaces and plunged the ruler into extravagance;

sentences.zh: 謀廢塚嫡，致國于傾危。

translations.literal: he plotted to depose the legitimate heir and brought the state to the brink of ruin.
translations.idiomatic: In time, he plotted to depose the legitimate heir and brought the state to the brink of ruin.

sentences.zh: 終使宗廟丘墟，市朝霜露，究其禍敗之源，實乃素之由也。

translations.literal: In the end he left the ancestral temples in ruins and the market and court exposed to frost and dew; tracing the source of disaster and defeat, it was indeed because of Su.
translations.idiomatic: In the end he left the ancestral temples in ruins and the market and court exposed to frost and dew. Tracing the source of disaster and defeat, it was indeed because of Su.

sentences.zh: 玄感宰相之子，荷恩二世，君之失德，當竭腹心。

translations.literal: Xuangan, son of a chief minister, received favor across two reigns; when the ruler lost virtue, he ought to have poured out his utmost loyalty.
translations.idiomatic: Xuangan, son of a chief minister, received favor across two reigns. When the ruler lost virtue, he ought to have poured out his utmost loyalty.

sentences.zh: 未議致身，先圖問鼎，假稱伊、霍之事，將肆莽、卓之心，人神同疾，敗不旋踵。

translations.literal: Before he had resolved to give his life, he first plotted to seize the throne, falsely claiming the cause of Yi and Huo while intending to unleash the heart of Wang Mang and Dong Zhuo — gods and men alike detested him, and defeat came without turning the heel.
translations.idiomatic: Before he had resolved to give his life, he first plotted to seize the throne, falsely claiming the cause of Yi while Huo while intending to unleash the heart of Wang Mang while Dong Zhuo — gods while men alike detested him, and defeat came without turning the heel.

sentences.zh: 昆弟就菹醢之誅，先人受焚如之酷，不亦甚乎。

translations.literal: His brothers suffered execution by mincing; his forebears endured the agony of burning alive — was it not excessive?
translations.idiomatic: His brothers suffered execution by mincing. His forebears endured the agony of burning alive — was it not excessive?

sentences.zh: 約外示溫柔，內懷狡算，為蛇畫足，終傾國本，俾無遺育，不亦宜哉。

translations.literal: Yue outwardly showed gentleness while inwardly harbored crafty schemes; adding feet to the snake, he ultimately overturned the foundation of the state — that none of his line should survive was only fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Yue outwardly showed gentleness while inwardly harbored crafty schemes. Adding feet to the snake, he ultimately overturned the foundation of the state — that none of his line should survive was only fitting.

sentences.zh: 寬閑關夷險，竟以功名自卒。

translations.literal: Kuan treated peril and ease with calm detachment, and in the end died having secured merit and fame for himself.
translations.idiomatic: And in the end died having secured merit and fame for himself, and kuan treated peril and ease with calm detachment.

sentences.zh: 文恩能以爵讓，其殆仁乎。

translations.literal: Wen'en could yield his rank and fief — was he not nearly benevolent?
translations.idiomatic: In time, wen'en could yield his rank and fief — was he not nearly benevolent?
